  "obj_lancerslideevent_slash_Step_0_gml_34_0": "* Kris^1, down here!/%",
  "obj_npc_susiedark_slash_Other_10_gml_13_0": "* Oh^1, you're not dead^2.&* Sweet./",
  "obj_npc_susiedark_slash_Other_10_gml_14_0": "\\E2* Got any idea what the heck this place is?/",
  "obj_npc_susiedark_slash_Other_10_gml_15_0": "\\E0* ... me neither./",
  "obj_npc_susiedark_slash_Other_10_gml_16_0": "* Wonder if there's anyone in that building up there...?/%",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_416_0": "* (It looks like a shop^1, but the door is locked^1, and no one's inside...)/%",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_419_0": "* (It's locked.)/%",
  "obj_npc_susiedark_slash_Other_10_gml_20_0": "* Maybe this place is an abandoned theme park?/",
  "obj_npc_susiedark_slash_Other_10_gml_21_0": "\\E0* Wait^1, where are the rides^1, then...?/",
  "obj_npc_susiedark_slash_Other_10_gml_22_0": "\\E2* Maybe they abandoned it 'cause there weren't any./%",
  "obj_savepoint_slash_Other_10_gml_51_0": "* In front of you^1, a castle looms beneath the empty town./",
  "obj_savepoint_slash_Other_10_gml_52_0": "* A black geyser emerges from it^1, piercing endlessly into the sky./",
  "obj_savepoint_slash_Other_10_gml_53_0": "* The power of this place shines within you./%",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_20_0": "* A castle...?/",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_21_0": "* Why the hell is there a castle inside a supply closet...?/%",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_32_0": "Welcome^1, heroes...!/%",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_46_0": "* Who's there!?/%",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_58_0": "Do not be alarmed..^1.&I am not your enemy./",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_59_0": "Please come forward^1,&both of you.../%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_128_0": "* Welcome^1.&* I am the \\cYPrince\\cW of this \\cYKingdom\\cW.../",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_129_0": "* The \\cYKINGDOM OF DARKNESS\\cW./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_130_0": "* Kris^1, Susie..^1.&* There is a \\cYLEGEND\\cW in this land./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_131_0": "* A LEGEND that one day^1, two \\cYHEROES of LIGHT\\cW will arrive,/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_132_0": "* And fulfill the ancient prophecy^1, foretold by time and space./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_133_0": "* Please^1, Heroes..^1.&* Listen to my tale.../",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_134_0": " \\C2 ",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_124_0": "#Listen",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_125_0": "#No",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_145_0": "* Very well then.../%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_149_0": "* .../",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_150_0": "\\E1* Umm, r-really^1?&* Are you sure^1?&* It's fairly important./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_151_0": "* And... um^1, in my opinion^1, it's a really nice \\cYPROPHECY\\cW!/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_152_0": "* I think you'd quite like it!/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_153_0": "\\C2 ",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_139_0": "#Listen",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_162_0": "\\E0* Phew^1!&* Um^1, very well then.../%",
  "obj_legend_slash_Draw_0_gml_13_0": "Once upon a time, a LEGEND&was whispered among shadows.",
  "obj_legend_slash_Draw_0_gml_21_0": "It was&a LEGEND&of HOPE.",
  "obj_legend_slash_Draw_0_gml_24_0": "It was&a LEGEND&of DREAMS.",
  "obj_legend_slash_Draw_0_gml_32_0": "It was&a LEGEND&of LIGHT.",
  "obj_legend_slash_Draw_0_gml_35_0": "It was&a LEGEND&of DARK.",
  "obj_legend_slash_Draw_0_gml_43_0": "This is the legend of&  ^3   DELTA RUNE",
  "obj_legend_slash_Draw_0_gml_98_0": "For millenia, LIGHT and DARK&have lived in balance^6,%",
  "obj_legend_slash_Draw_0_gml_99_0": "Bringing peace to the WORLD.",
  "obj_legend_slash_Draw_0_gml_113_0": "But if this harmony&were to shatter...",
  "obj_legend_slash_Draw_0_gml_151_0": "A terrible calamity would occur.",
  "obj_legend_slash_Draw_0_gml_170_0": "The sky will run&black with terror",
  "obj_legend_slash_Draw_0_gml_205_0": "And the land will&crack with fear.",
  "obj_legend_slash_Draw_0_gml_212_0": "Then^1, her heart pounding...",
  "obj_legend_slash_Draw_0_gml_219_0": "The EARTH will draw&her final breath.",
  "obj_legend_slash_Draw_0_gml_233_0": "Only then^1, shining with hope...",
  "obj_legend_slash_Draw_0_gml_253_0": "Three HEROES appear&at WORLDS' edge.",
  "obj_legend_slash_Draw_0_gml_301_0": "A HUMAN,",
  "obj_legend_slash_Draw_0_gml_309_0": "A MONSTER,",
  "obj_legend_slash_Draw_0_gml_317_0": "And a PRINCE&FROM THE DARK.",
  "obj_legend_slash_Draw_0_gml_356_0": "Only they can seal the fountains",
  "obj_legend_slash_Draw_0_gml_387_0": "And banish the ANGEL'S HEAVEN.",
  "obj_legend_slash_Draw_0_gml_394_0": "Only then will balance&be restored,",
  "obj_legend_slash_Draw_0_gml_401_0": "And the WORLD saved&from destruction.",
  "obj_legend_slash_Draw_0_gml_426_0": "Today, the FOUNTAIN OF DARKNESS-",
  "obj_legend_slash_Draw_0_gml_451_0": "The geyser that&gives this land form-",
  "obj_legend_slash_Draw_0_gml_459_0": "Stands tall at the&center of the kingdom.",
  "obj_legend_slash_Draw_0_gml_466_0": "But recently, another fountain&has appeared on the horizon...",
  "obj_legend_slash_Draw_0_gml_473_0": "And with it^1, the balance of&LIGHT and DARK begins to shift...",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_140_0": "#We know it#Already",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_168_0": "* ... really^1?&* You've heard it already?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_169_0": "* Oh..^1. Perhaps I shouldn't have rehearsed it so much.../",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_171_0": "* Look^1, dude^1, we didn't come here for a bedtime story./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_172_0": "* Just tell us how to get home./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_174_0": "* Ummm^1, the easiest way would be to seal the \\cYEastern FOUNTAIN\\cW./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_176_0": "* Fountain?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_177_0": "\\E1* You mean^1, uh^1, like the water bubbler or something?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_179_0": "* THE fountain^1.&* That which gives the \\cYDARK WORLD\\cW form./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_180_0": "\\E1* ... umm^1, are you sure you actually know the legend?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_182_0": "* Look./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_183_0": "* .../",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_184_0": "* No./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_185_0": "* But I think I've got enough info./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_186_0": "* See you two later./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_188_0": "* W-wait^1!&* Let me at least tell you how to.../%",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_142_0": "* Kris^1, Susie..^1.&* Thank you for listening to my long tale./",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_143_0": "* I deeply believe you two are the \\cYHEROES\\cW of the \\cYLEGEND\\cW./",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_144_0": "* That despite whatever enemies you may face.../",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_145_0": "* ... You two have the \\cYCOURAGE\\cW to \\cYSAVE THE WORLD\\cW./",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_146_0": "* \\cYDELTA WARRIORS\\cW!^1 &* Please^1, won't you accept your destiny...?/%",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_181_0": "* Uhhh..^3.&* Nah./",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_183_0": "* W... what?/",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_185_0": "* Me^1?&* Some kind of hero or something...?/",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_186_0": "\\E2* You've got the wrong person./",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_188_0": "* B-but Susie^1, without you^1, the...&* The world will.../",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_190_0": "* So what?&* If the world gets destroyed.../",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_191_0": "\\E1* It's none of my damn business./",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_192_0": "\\E2* Might even be kind of fun, honestly./",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_194_0": "* .../",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_196_0": "* Anyway^1, Kris.../",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_197_0": "\\E0* If YOU wanna play pretend with this weirdo.../",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_198_0": "\\E1* Stick around./",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_199_0": "\\E2* I'M going to find a way out of here./",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_201_0": "* Susie..^1.&* Wait!/%",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_276_0": "* Ho ho ho!/",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_277_0": "\\E0* The heroes are already running away.../",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_278_0": "\\E1* And they didn't even know I was here./",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_279_0": "\\E3* My dad's gonna make me Son of the Month!/",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_288_0": "\\E3* My dad's gonna make me Son of the Month!/",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_281_0": "* Who the hell are you!?/",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_283_0": "* I'm...!/%",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_287_0": "* Ho ho ho^1!&* One nerd down^1, two to go!/",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_290_0": "* Who the hell are you!?/",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_292_0": "* I'm...!/%",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_327_0": "* The bad guy./",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_328_0": "\\E0* You \\cYCLOWNS\\cW want to seal our \\cYDARK FOUNTAIN\\cW, huh!?/",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_329_0": "\\E2* And ^2- STILL picturing you guys as \\cYCLOWNS\\cW -/",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_330_0": "\\E0* Save the world from ETERNAL DARKNESS, huh!?/",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_332_0": "\\E0* Eh./",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_334_0": "* Don't try to deny it...!/",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_335_0": "\\E0* We both know you'll go \\cYEAST\\cW!/",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_336_0": "* It's your only way home!/",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_337_0": "\\E2* But^1, I^1, LANCER^1, won't let you go there!/",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_338_0": "\\E0* And I've got a flawless two step plan to ensure it./",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_339_0": "\\E2* Step one^3.&* I thrash you./",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_340_0": "\\E1* Step two^3.&* You lose!/",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_342_0": "\\E1* Hmm^2. Nice plan^1, kid./",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_344_0": "\\E6* R-really...?/",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_346_0": "\\E2* Yeah, actually.../",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_347_0": "\\E3* Mind if we use it on you instead?/%",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_360_0": "* The bad guy./",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_362_0": "\\E0* \"Bad guy?\"/",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_364_0": "\\E6* You know^2.&* Teardrop-headed kid^2.&* From the legend?/",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_366_0": "\\E1* ... No?/",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_368_0": "\\E4* Aw boy^2.&* This is gonna be hard to explain./%",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_388_0": "* Umm..^1.&* I could help explain it...!/",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_390_0": "\\E0* Stay out of this^2, kindboy!/",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_392_0": "\\E0* No^1!&* I'll protect the heroes with my life!/",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_394_0": "\\E0* Actually^1, can you hold off?&* I wanna hear this kid./%",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_412_0": "\\E6* OK^1, so^1, long story short^2.&* You guys are heroes./",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_413_0": "* You wanna go EAST^2, and seal our DARK FOUNTAIN./",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_414_0": "\\E6* That'll stop darkness from covering the world./",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_415_0": "* We^2, on the other hand^2, don't want that^2, because:/",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_416_0": "\\E1* It would rule^2, and be great./",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_418_0": "\\E2* Wait^2, why DO we want to stop that?/",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_420_0": "\\E7* Uhh^1, I dunno..^2.&* I guess I could go ask my dad?/%",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_440_0": "* I could tell you!/",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_442_0": "* We GOT this./%",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_460_0": "\\E1* So the POINT is^2, you wanna fight us?/",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_462_0": "\\E1* Correct-a-mundo!/",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_465_0": "\\E3* NOW you're telling me something I understand./%",
  "scr_monstersetup_slash_scr_monstersetup_gml_51_0": "* Lancer busts in!",
  "scr_monstersetup_slash_scr_monstersetup_gml_32_0": "Lancer",
  "scr_monstersetup_slash_scr_monstersetup_gml_16_0": "Check",
  "scr_monstersetup_slash_scr_monstersetup_gml_50_0": "Compliment",
  "obj_lancerboss_slash_Step_0_gml_118_0": "* LANCER - AT 7 DF 1&* Not to call a spade a spade^1, but he's a spade./",
  "obj_lancerboss_slash_Step_0_gml_119_0": "* Not old enough to ride a motorcycle^1, so he set his bike on fire./%",
  "obj_lancerboss_slash_Step_0_gml_17_0": "Halt, clowns!&This bike is&fueled by&victory!!!",
  "obj_lancerboss_slash_Step_0_gml_100_0": "* Dunno how I got an ax but^1, like^1, that's cool.",
  "obj_lancerboss_slash_Step_0_gml_130_0": "* You tell Lancer to watch out for Susie's attack^1.&* He readies himself./%",
  "obj_lancerboss_slash_Step_0_gml_18_0": "I love to get&thrashed...&Just kidding!&That's you!!",
  "obj_lancerboss_slash_Step_0_gml_90_0": "* Lancer's riding it out.",
  "obj_lancerboss_slash_Step_0_gml_164_0": "* You tell Lancer you can't tell the difference between his clothes and his body./",
  "obj_lancerboss_slash_Step_0_gml_165_0": "* He seems flattered..^1.&* His ATTACK POWER went down!/%",
  "obj_lancerboss_slash_Step_0_gml_26_0": "Oh! You make&my feelings&do wheelies!&Sweet wheelys",
  "obj_lancerboss_slash_Step_0_gml_157_0": "* You try to compliment LANCER again.../",
  "obj_lancerboss_slash_Step_0_gml_158_0": "* But he sees it as insincere^1.&* His ATTACK POWER goes back up!/%",
  "obj_lancerboss_slash_Step_0_gml_30_0": "Did you not&realize I can&mask my self-&esteem levels?",
  "obj_lancerboss_slash_Step_0_gml_150_0": "* You compliment LANCER^1.&* He gets confused as to your sincerity./",
  "obj_lancerboss_slash_Step_0_gml_151_0": "* Instead of going up or down^1, his ATTACK power goes sideways...?/%",
  "obj_lancerboss_slash_Step_0_gml_34_0": "Stop!! My&personality's&getting too&deep!!!",
  "obj_lancerboss_slash_Step_0_gml_145_0": "* You say some kind words^1.&* Lancer absorbs them into his skin./%",
  "obj_lancerboss_slash_Step_0_gml_19_0": "So what are&you guys doing&after this???",
  "obj_lancerboss_slash_Step_0_gml_91_0": "* Lancer is thinking about chips.",
  "obj_lancerboss_slash_Step_0_gml_92_0": "* Lancer's motorcycle is actually just a bike that's on fire.",
  "obj_lancerboss_slash_Step_0_gml_20_0": "Hohoho!!!&I'm the bad&guy!",
  "obj_lancerboss_slash_Step_0_gml_93_0": "* Lancer switches gears randomly to appear competent.",
  "obj_lancerboss_slash_Step_0_gml_94_0": "* Lancer revs viciously.",
  "obj_lancerboss_slash_Step_0_gml_135_0": "* Lancer laughs at the idea he would need your help!/%",
  "obj_lancerboss_slash_Step_0_gml_196_0": "Wait^1!&Wait a second!/",
  "obj_lancerboss_slash_Step_0_gml_197_0": "My bike's&running&out of&fuel...!/",
  "obj_lancerboss_slash_Step_0_gml_198_0": "Alright,&you punk-&a-roos!/",
  "obj_lancerboss_slash_Step_0_gml_199_0": "You had the&luck of the&draw this&time^1, but.../",
  "obj_lancerboss_slash_Step_0_gml_200_0": "Next time^1,&the losers&will be&YOU!!!/",
  "obj_lancerboss_slash_Step_0_gml_201_0": "Hahaha!!^1!&Bye^1, losers!!/",
  "obj_lancerboss_slash_Step_0_gml_202_0": "I gotta get&home before&dinner!!!/%",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_552_0": "* Are you two OK...?/%",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_569_0": "* Um^1, allow me to introduce myself more properly^1, I am.../",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_571_0": "* Jeez^1, can you take off that hood?/",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_572_0": "* I can barely hear you under there./",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_574_0": "* U-ummm^1, alright.../%",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_611_0": "* Hello everyone^1.&* I'm Ralsei./",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_612_0": "\\E0* Kris, Susie..^2.&* It's ever so wonderful to meet you!/",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_613_0": "\\E8* I'm certain we're going to become great friends^2, and,/",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_615_0": "\\E0* Best way to leave is East^2, right?/",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_617_0": "\\E0* Yes^2!&* That's where we'll.../",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_619_0": "\\E0* Got it./%",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_637_0": "* See ya at school^1, Kris./%",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_663_0": "* Umm.../",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_664_0": "\\E6* I suppose it's just the two of us^1, then.../%",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_702_0": "\\E5* Kris^1, I'm a \\cYPRINCE\\cW, but.../",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_703_0": "\\E6* I^1, um^1, currently don't have any subjects./",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_704_0": "\\E5* I've been waiting alone here.../",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_705_0": "\\E6* Um..^1. My whole life for you two to arrive./",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_706_0": "\\E0* So..^2.&* I'm really happy to meet you./",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_707_0": "\\E8* I hope we can be good friends^2, Kris./%",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_723_0": "* Let's try to find Susie^1.&* She must be to the southeast./%",
  "obj_darkcastle_event_slash_Step_0_gml_749_0": "* You can lead the way^1, Kris!/%",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_429_0": "* Hey^1, Kris^1, I really think we should catch up with Susie./",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_430_0": "\\E1* We can come back here after our adventure is over.../",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_431_0": "\\E8* ... and then I can bake you a yummy cake!/%",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_435_0": "* Kris^1, perhaps we should save the world first...?/",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_436_0": "\\E0* It seems a bit important./%",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_446_0": "* Come to think of it^1, how did Lancer get up there...?/",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_447_0": "\\E6* I suppose he rode his bike up the side of the cliff...?/%",
  "obj_savepoint_slash_Other_10_gml_57_0": "* Ralsei^1, the lonely prince^1, is now your ally./",
  "obj_savepoint_slash_Other_10_gml_58_0": "* The power of fluffy boys shines within you./%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_292_0": "\\E3* Oh^1, Kris^1!&* It's the training dummy I made!/",

  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_302_0": "\\E0* OK^1!&* Get ready, Kris!/%",

  "obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_87_0": "\\E0* See that \\cRHEART\\cW, Kris?/",

  "obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_92_0": "\\E3* If everyone's HP reaches 0^1, we'll lose the battle./",
  "obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_93_0": "\\E0* So^1, please take care to avoid the enemy's attack./",

  "obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_136_0": "\\E9* .../%",
  "obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_602_0": "\\E6* Ouch^1, it's OK^1, Kris^1! You're still learning!/",
  "obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_598_0": "* Great job^1, Kris^1!&* You're a natural!/",
  "obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_604_0": "\\E8* Anyhow^1, after the enemy attacks^1, it's our turn^1, Kris!/",

  "obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_610_0": "* Let's try FIGHTing!&  (\\I0   )",

  "obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_733_0": "* Kris^1, if you didn't notice^1, when you DEFENDED before -/",

  "obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_735_0": "* How about spending that TP on one of my \\cYSPELLs\\cW?/",
  "obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_736_0": "* Because you hit the enemy enough^1, it got \\cBTIRED\\cW./",
  "obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_737_0": "* Now^1, if I use my \\cYPACIFY\\cW spell on it.../",
  "obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_738_0": "* It'll fall asleep^1, and we'll win peacefully!/%",
  "obj_dummyenemy_slash_Draw_0_gml_4_0": "(Tired)",
  "obj_tutorialbattleevent_slash_Step_0_gml_87_0": "\\E8* Oh^1, that was fun^1!&* You're a wonderful student^1, Kris!/",
  "obj_tutorialbattleevent_slash_Step_0_gml_88_0": "\\E1* ... and^1, er^1, in case you ever need a refresher, I.../",
  "obj_tutorialbattleevent_slash_Step_0_gml_89_0": "\\E8* Here^1!&* I wrote a Manual for you and Susie!/",
  "obj_tutorialbattleevent_slash_Step_0_gml_90_0": "\\E0* Press ",
  "obj_tutorialbattleevent_slash_Step_0_gml_90_1": " to open the menu and use it in your ITEMS./",
  "obj_tutorialbattleevent_slash_Step_0_gml_92_0": "* (You got the Manual.)/%",
  "scr_itemuse_slash_scr_itemuse_gml_71_0": "* (You tried to read the manual^1, but it was so dense it made your head spin...)/%",
  "obj_tutorialbattleevent_slash_Step_0_gml_95_0": "\\E6* Sorry^1, Kris^1. I'll try to be a better teacher next time./",
  "obj_tutorialbattleevent_slash_Step_0_gml_96_0": "\\E1* ... Actually^1, umm^1, if you prefer to read^1, instead.../",
  "obj_darkcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_129_0": "* .../%",
  "obj_darkcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_135_0": "* (You tossed the Manual hard.^1)&* (Its pages scatter in the wind.)/",
  "obj_darkcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_137_0": "* ............../",
  "obj_darkcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_138_0": "\\E5* Umm..^1.&* Th-that's OK^1, Kris^1!&* I can always.../",
  "obj_darkcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_139_0": "\\E6* I'll just make a better one next time!/%",
  "obj_darkcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_147_0": "* (You drop the manual on the floor with a resounding thud.)/",
  "obj_darkcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_149_0": "* Hey^1, Kris^1.&* What are you doing...?/",
  "obj_darkcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_150_0": "\\E3* Oh no^1!&* Is that the manual?/",
  "obj_darkcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_151_0": "\\E1* Looks like you accidentally dropped it.../",
  "obj_darkcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_152_0": "\\E8* Here you go^1, Kris^1!&* You don't wanna lose that!/",
  "obj_darkcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_154_0": "* (You got the Manual.^1)&* (Again.)/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_231_0": "* Er^1, Kris^1, you know you can hold ~1 to run...?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_226_0": "#I know",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_227_0": "#Really!?",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_249_0": "* Right^1!&* You'll move faster by holding ~1!/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_250_0": "\\E8* And I'll be right behind you^1, so don't worry!/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_251_0": "\\E6* ... Unless you want to get away^1, in which case^1, sorry./%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_241_0": "* Really^1?&* And yet you choose not to...?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_242_0": "\\E6* Right^1, who knows how long these leisurely days will last.../",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_243_0": "\\E0* There's nothing wrong with taking your time^1, Kris./%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_261_0": "* Umm^1, Kris^1, did you know.../",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_262_0": "* ... You can skip text by pressing ",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_262_1": "?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_257_0": "#I know",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_258_0": "#Really!?",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_272_0": "* ... Really^1?&* So you've just been.../",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_273_0": "\\E2* Listening to me talk^1, because you wanted to?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_274_0": "\\E6* I'll try to make it worth your while^1, Kris!/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_279_0": "* Right^1! In the case you read very quickly./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_280_0": "\\E1* Or you're tired of what's being said./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_281_0": "\\E6* ... No need to skip my text^1, right^1, Kris?/%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_41_0": "* (It's just a dummy.)/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_322_0": "\\E3* Oh my^2!&* The Great Door is opened?!/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_323_0": "* No wonder Lancer was able to come through.../",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_324_0": "\\E1* .../",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_325_0": "* Kris, once we pass through this door.../",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_326_0": "* Our adventure will really begin./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_327_0": "* A journey foretold exactly by the prophecy.../",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_328_0": "\\E6* But^1, Kris^1, I believe YOUR choices are important^1, too./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_329_0": "\\E0* This world is full of all kinds of people^1, Kris./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_330_0": "\\E6* In the end^1, how we treat them makes all the difference./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_331_0": "\\E8* So let's try our best to get by without FIGHTing./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_332_0": "\\E1* If we can manage to do that.../",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_333_0": "\\E0* I believe this tale may have a happy ending./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_334_0": "\\E6* Otherwise^1, I fear that.../",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_335_0": "\\E1* ... you may not..^1. find the result favorable./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_336_0": "\\E3* ... Oh^1, I'm sorry^1! Is that too much to ask?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_232_0": " \\C2",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_318_0": "#I can#handle it",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_319_0": "#.....#",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_342_0": "\\E0* Kris^1, I knew you were a hero the moment I saw you./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_343_0": "\\E8* Let's try our best^1, alright?/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_347_0": "\\E3* O-oh^1, I'm sorry!/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_348_0": "\\E6* Kris^1, in the end^1, what you choose is up to you./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_349_0": "\\E8* As long as you're happy with it^1, I'm happy too./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_350_0": "\\E0* So just try your best^1, and don't worry!/%",
  "obj_savepoint_slash_Other_10_gml_66_0": "* With the door closed behind you^1, your adventure will truly begin.../",
  "obj_savepoint_slash_Other_10_gml_67_0": "* The power of adventure shines within you./%",
  "obj_savepoint_slash_Other_10_gml_71_0": "* The door is still closed./",
  "obj_savepoint_slash_Other_10_gml_72_0": "* The power of backtracking shines within you./%",
  "obj_npc_sign_slash_Other_10_gml_12_0": "* (Enemies ahead!^1 You're gonna die!^1)&* (SIGNED, LANCER)/%",
  "scr_encountersetup_slash_scr_encountersetup_gml_82_0": "* Rudinn drew near!",
  "scr_monstersetup_slash_scr_monstersetup_gml_44_0": "Check",
  "scr_monstersetup_slash_scr_monstersetup_gml_117_0": "Convince",
  "scr_monstersetup_slash_scr_monstersetup_gml_26_0": "Lecture",
  "obj_diamondenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_154_0": "* RUDINN - AT 6 DF 0&* This ambivalent diamond isn't any girl's best friend./%",
  "obj_diamondenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_14_0": "Face my&Diamond&Cutter!",
  "obj_diamondenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_81_0": "* Smells like jewelry.",
  "obj_diamondenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_163_0": "* You told Rudinn to quit fighting^1.&* It was utterly swayed./%",
  "obj_diamondenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_24_0": "Yeah I&guess that&makes&sense.",
  "obj_diamondenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_77_0": "* Rudinn is glimmering plainly.",
  "obj_diamondenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_78_0": "* Rudinn has no strong opinions one way or the other.",
  "obj_diamondenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_79_0": "* Rudinn thinks about elaborate stones.",
  "obj_diamondenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_80_0": "* Rudinn dislikes its boss^1, but doesn't care enough to quit.",
  "obj_npc_sign_slash_Other_10_gml_13_0": "* (If you're reading this...^1& I guess you're dead.)&* (SIGNED, LANCER)/%",
  "obj_npc_sign_slash_Other_10_gml_30_0": "* (Hey^1, don't read this sign! It's a work in progress!)&* (SIGNED^1, LANCER)/%",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_210_0": "* Ho ho ho... if it isn't my two favorite people./",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_211_0": "\\E1* Psyche!&* You guys aren't even in my top five!!/",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_213_0": "* Lancer^1!&* Where's Susie?/",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_215_0": "\\E3* You mean the purple girl...^1?&* Ho ho ho.../",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_216_0": "\\E1* You fools^1!&* You're too late to stop me...!/",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_218_0": "* What did you do?/",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_220_0": "\\E1* Hahaha.. It was SO simple!/",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_221_0": "\\E3* She beat me up, so I ran away...!/",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_223_0": "* That's a bit anticlimatic.../%",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_230_0": "* So^1, are you just going to stand there?/",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_231_0": "\\E8* I thought you would at least run to the right.../",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_233_0": "* Why!? The purple girl's over there!/%",
  "obj_npc_sign_slash_Other_10_gml_41_0": "* (These types of trees DON'T contain an item that can heal you.)/",
  "obj_npc_sign_slash_Other_10_gml_42_0": "* (Whatever you do^1, DON'T check the tree and use ",
  "obj_npc_sign_slash_Other_10_gml_42_1": " to open your menu!)/",
  "obj_npc_sign_slash_Other_10_gml_43_0": "* (You got it!?)&* (SIGNED^1, LANCER)/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_363_0": "* (There are two objects hanging from the tree.)/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_364_0": "* (Take one?)/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_13_0": "\\C2",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_357_0": "#Yes",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_358_0": "#No",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_387_0": "* (You got the Dark Candy.)/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_392_0": "* (You can't carry any more.)/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_398_0": "* (You decided to let the tree keep it.)/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_369_0": "* (There's a candy hanging from the tree.)/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_370_0": "* (Take one?)/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_365_0": "\\C2",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_376_0": "* (There's nothing hanging low enough to take.)/%",
  "obj_event_room_slash_Step_0_gml_11_0": "\\E2* Hey^1, if you head that way, my troops will thrash you./",
  "obj_event_room_slash_Step_0_gml_13_0": "* Is that a threat?/",
  "obj_event_room_slash_Step_0_gml_15_0": "\\E3* I prefer to think of it as an invitation./%",
  "obj_event_room_slash_Step_0_gml_20_0": "* Hey, aren't you guys gonna even say hi!?/",
  "obj_event_room_slash_Step_0_gml_22_0": "* Um^1, no./",
  "obj_event_room_slash_Step_0_gml_24_0": "* Cool^1.&* Enjoy being thrashed by various guys./%",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_239_0": "\\E0* Oh^1, you came back./",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_241_0": "* If we say hi^1, will your troops NOT thrash us?/",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_243_0": "\\E3* Ralsei^1, Ralsei^1, Ralsei^1.../",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_244_0": "\\E1* The thrashing is what makes our relationship work./",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_246_0": "* What relationship!?/%",
  "scr_encountersetup_slash_scr_encountersetup_gml_100_0": "* A necklace of Rudinns blocks your path.",
  "obj_diamondenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_173_0": "* You lectured the enemies on the importance of kindness./",
  "obj_diamondenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_174_0": "* The enemies became \\cBTIRED\\cW.../%",
  "obj_diamondenemy_slash_Draw_0_gml_6_0": "(Tired)",
  "obj_diamondenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_177_0": "(Tired)",
  "obj_diamondenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_28_0": "(Yawn)...&What? OK...",
  "obj_diamondenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_11_0": "Long live&the guy&who pays us!",
  "obj_diamondenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_12_0": "Shine,&shine",
  "obj_diamondenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_13_0": "I'm just a&normal&person.",
  "obj_diamondenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_82_0": "* Rudinn is starting to fall asleep.",
  "obj_diamondenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_83_0": "* Rudinn's luster begins to fade.",
  "obj_diamondenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_84_0": "* Rudinn is alright with not fighting.",
  "obj_diamondenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_118_0": "Alright^1,&you convinced&me!!/%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_81_0": "* Mama miba^1! I'm TOPCHEF^1!&* My latest cake worked me to exhaustion!/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_82_0": "* So I took a little nap..^1.&* But^1, Mama miba^1!&* A scary noise woke me up!/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_83_0": "* A beast was hunched on the table^1, eating the cake like an animal!/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_84_0": "* I spritzed it with water^1, and it hissed and ran off^1!&* But^1, my wonderful cake is.../",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_86_0": "* Aww^1, Kris^1, that sounds like Susie^1! We must be going the right way!/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_87_0": "\\E1* Let's try to keep her out of any more trouble!/%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_90_0": "* M-M-Mama miba^1! M-M-Mama SHIBA^1!&* You know that beast!^1?&* Please don't come back.../%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_95_0": "* Mama miba^1! Mom AMOEBA^1!&* Y-You're the beast that ate my cake!/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_97_0": "* Yeah^1? So^1? Want me to spit it back out?/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_99_0": "* N-no^1, that's quite fine.../",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_101_0": "* Ya sure^1? 'd probably make it better./%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_104_0": "* Why are you looking at me like that!?/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_106_0": "* I don't trust anyone that won't eat my spit./",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_108_0": "* ... So you don't trust anyone?/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_110_0": "* Yeah./%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_456_0": "* (Take a piece?)/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_263_0": " \\C2",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_403_0": "#Yes",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_404_0": "#No",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_455_0": "* (The remains of the cake are still smoldering...)/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_472_0": "* (The Broken Cake was added to your \\cYKEY ITEMS\\cW.)/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_438_0": "* (You can't carry any more.)/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_483_0": "* (You decided putting cake in your pockets is a bad idea.)/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_461_0": "* (The remains of the cake are still smoldering...)/%",
  "scr_encountersetup_slash_scr_encountersetup_gml_116_0": "* Rudinn and Hathy blocked the way!",
  "obj_heartenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_80_0": "* Hathy smiled a darling smile.",
  "obj_heartenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_81_0": "* Hathy is whispering a lovely spell.",
  "obj_heartenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_82_0": "* Hathy has a little secret.",
  "obj_heartenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_83_0": "* Smells like a soft kiss.",
  "obj_heartenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_168_0": "* You and Ralsei warned Hathy about Susie^1.&* The enemy went on guard./%",
  "obj_heartenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_170_0": "* You and Ralsei  warned the enemies about Susie^1.&* Everyone went on guard./%",
  "obj_heartenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_173_0": "(Warned)",
  "obj_heartenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_179_0": "* You ordered Susie to flatter all the enemies!/",
  "obj_heartenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_182_0": "* Can't believe my bozo teammates.../",
  "obj_heartenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_183_0": "\\E0* ... came back here just to see YOU guys./%",
  "obj_heartenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_184_0": "\\E0* ... wanted to fight someone like YOU so much./%",
  "obj_heartenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_185_0": "\\E0* ... have a THING for weaklings like you./%",
  "scr_monstersetup_slash_scr_monstersetup_gml_146_0": "Flatter",
  "scr_monstersetup_slash_scr_monstersetup_gml_148_0": "X-Flatter",
  "obj_heartenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_127_0": "* HATHY - AT 7 DF 0&* I am a \\cYlittle kiss\\cW./%",
  "obj_heartenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_136_0": "* You told Hathy it has cool tentacles^1.&* It began to think about this.../%",
  "obj_heartenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_137_0": "* You called Hathy a sweetheart^1.&* It began to think about this.../%",
  "obj_heartenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_138_0": "* You told Hathy its teeth look like knives^1.&* It began to think about this.../%",
  "obj_heartenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_147_0": "* You ordered Ralsei to flatter all the enemies!/",
  "obj_heartenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_150_0": "* Out of anyone^1, I'm glad we randomly encountered all of you./%",
  "obj_heartenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_151_0": "* I'm making tea later..^1.&* Umm^1, would you like any?/%",
  "obj_heartenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_152_0": "* We don't need EXP^1.&* Just encountering your smile is reward enough./%",
  "obj_heartenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_84_0": "* Hathy's beat slows.",
  "obj_heartenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_85_0": "* Hathy's beat seems to stutter.",
  "obj_heartenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_86_0": "* Hathy is skipping beats.",
  "obj_heartenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_223_0": "* Where'd you get it^1?&* Heh heh heh heh./",
  "obj_heartenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_225_0": "* (Umm^1, Kris^1, maybe Susie shouldn't ACT anymore...)/%",
  "obj_heartenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_228_0": "\\E7* H-hey^1, what gives!?/",
  "obj_heartenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_230_0": "* (Wow^1, that was close^1, Kris...)/",
  "obj_heartenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_231_0": "* (Maybe Susie shouldn't ACT anymore...)/%",
  "obj_heartenemy_slash_Draw_0_gml_6_0": "(Tired)",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_409_0": "* (There are two objects hanging from the tree.)/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_410_0": "* (Take one?)/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_295_0": " \\C2",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_449_0": "#Yes",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_450_0": "#No",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_433_0": "* (You got the Dark Candy.)/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_477_0": "* (You can't carry any more.)/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_444_0": "* (You decided to let the tree keep it.)/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_415_0": "* (There's a candy hanging from the tree.)/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_416_0": "* (Take one?)/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_337_0": " \\C2",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_422_0": "* (There's nothing hanging low enough to take.)/%",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_452_0": "* Check the clock^1.&* In order to solve this puzzle^1, you'll have to hurry./%",
  "obj_npc_sign_slash_Other_10_gml_49_0": "* (Behold, the Maze of Death!&* Prepare to GET LOST, clowns!!!)&* (SIGNED^1, LANCER)/%",
  "obj_npc_sign_slash_Other_10_gml_52_0": "* (Feeling lost yet!? You must be UTTERLY HELPLESS among these twists and turns!)/",

  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1205_0": "Bye",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1233_0": "* You get TP when you DEFEND^1.&* Protect yourself^1, then cast SPELLs^1, friend./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1234_0": "* You also get TP by getting close to bullets./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1235_0": "* Look for the heart outline when you get close to bullets./",

  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1214_0": "* TP^1? What's TP^1?&* That's what lets you cast SPELLS^1, see!?/",

  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1218_0": "* ... no^1, it stands for Tension Points./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1220_0": "\\M1* What^1, really!?/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1224_0": "* TP only lasts^1, inside a fight^1.&* Once you win^1, it's out of sight./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1225_0": "* Having extra^1, feels unbearable^1.&* No point in saving^1, it's straight-up terrible./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1227_0": "* But leftover TP turns into extra money at the end of battle.../",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1229_0": "\\M1* You mean I only should have been using one square!?/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1211_0": "* Later^1, kid./%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1255_0": "* I'm Ralsei Master^1.&* Ask me about RALSEI's./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_636_0": "\\C4 ",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1251_0": " #Pacify",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1252_0": " #Healing",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1253_0": "Fact",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1254_0": "Bye",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1263_0": "* Ralsei's spell's called PACIFY^1.&* Use it on BABIES^1, before they CRY./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1265_0": "* What^1? It safely removes a \"TIRED\" enemy from combat./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1267_0": "\\M1* What if you're fighting a BABY!?/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1281_0": "* Ralsei loves when you give us MONEY./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1282_0": "* He will hug you^1, and call you HONEY./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1284_0": "* Hey^1, that's not true!/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1285_0": "\\E8* You don't need money to get me to do that!/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1272_0": "* Ralsei has a spell that HEALS^1, dude./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1273_0": "* Why use that^1, when you can eat FOOD?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1275_0": "* Because you won't have to use up an ITEM?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1277_0": "\\M1* I could have avoided all those empty calories!?/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1260_0": "* Later^1, kid./%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1294_0": "* I'm Susie Master^1.&* Ask me about SUSIE's./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_831_0": "\\C4 ",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1290_0": " #Warning",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1291_0": " #Attack",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1292_0": "Fact",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1293_0": "Bye",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1302_0": "* When KRIS uses WARNING^1, SUSIE can't hit^1.&* So make sure to -/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1304_0": "* So there's no reason to use it./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1306_0": "\\M1* Unless..^1.&* Unless you wanted not to hurt -/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1308_0": "* SO THERE'S NO REASON./%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1348_0": "* Susie loves^1, when you give us MONEY^1.&* She will -/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1350_0": "* Nope^1, don't care./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1352_0": "\\M1* Did I say something funny!?/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1325_0": "* Susie always attacks^1, the foe on top./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1326_0": "* She'll smash them^1, with a crushing chop./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1327_0": "* She always strikes^1, at the first thing she sees.../",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_965_0": "* .../",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1331_0": "\\M1* Oh no^1, oh no^1!&* She's looking at ME!/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1312_0": "* Susie's gone^1, I'm afraid^1, I'm afreet./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1313_0": "*Seems like WARNING is obsolete./%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1317_0": "* The days of WARNing^1, have long since past./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1318_0": "* The circumstances^1, changed pretty fast./%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1335_0": "* Susie's gone^1, so no attack./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1336_0": "* Will you two pick up the slack?/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1341_0": "* Susie's BUSTER^1, RUDE as may be^1.../",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1342_0": "* Will deal more damage^1, if you just press ~1!/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1355_0": "* Susie's gone^1, so no facts./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1356_0": "* Will you two pick up the slackts?/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1360_0": "* SUSIE seems to have changed^1, just a hair./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1361_0": "* That kind of growth is actually rare./%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1299_0": "* Later^1, kid./%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1377_0": "* I'm Kris Master^1.&* Ask me about KRIS's./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_967_0": "\\C4 ",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1373_0": " #Reviving",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1374_0": " #Acting",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1375_0": "Fact",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1376_0": "Bye",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1385_0": "* When HP goes negative^1, your friends fall down/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1386_0": "* But bringing them back^1, is easy-town/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1387_0": "* Plain foods and spells^1, work like a charm -/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1388_0": "* And with a MINT^1, you can cure all HARM./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1390_0": "* Even normal items and spells can revive people^1, huh?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1392_0": "* Yeah^1, that's what I'm saying!/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1409_0": "* It's a good idea^1, to give us BUCKs./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1410_0": "* It'll make you happy^1, and fill you with LUCKs./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1411_0": "* Over there^1, is our DONATION HOLE./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1412_0": "* We had a BOX^1, but it got STOLE./%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1397_0": "* If you only ACT^1, you might start to think -/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1398_0": "* What about the guy with the scarf in pink?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1400_0": "* If you know ACTing will make the enemy friendly -/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1401_0": "* Then you can ask me to SPARE on the SAME TURN./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1402_0": "* Or^1, cast PACIFY if you know they'll get TIRED./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1403_0": "* If you plan ahead^1, a lot can happen in ONE TURN!/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1405_0": "\\M1* Hey^1, who's the MASTER here^1, me or you!?/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1382_0": "* Later^1, kid./%",
  "obj_npc_sign_slash_Other_10_gml_74_0": "* \"Hole Goals\"/",
  "obj_npc_sign_slash_Other_10_gml_75_0": "$1 - Monthly tutorial, weekly.&$10 - Weekly tutorial, monthly.&$100 - Stop making tutorials./%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_269_0": "* The KING didn't even give us severance pay.../",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_270_0": "* His son just gave us all beanies..^1.&* Itchy beanies.../%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1421_0": "* \"Donation Hole\"/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1422_0": "* (If you like our tutorials^1, please throw your money into a hole.)/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_745_0": "\\C2 ",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1417_0": " #Throw $1",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1418_0": " #Do not",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1433_0": "* (You put a dollar in the \"Hole.\")/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1434_0": "* (The \"Hole\" became \"Full.\")/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1426_0": "* (The hole is filled to the brim with cash.)/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1440_0": "* (You don't have enough money.)/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1441_0": "* (You failed to budget enough money to throw into a hole...)/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1446_0": "* (You decided to save the dollar for a different hole.)/%",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_99_0": "\\E0* Hee hee..^1.&* Welcome, travellers.",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_106_0": "Buy",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_107_0": "Sell",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_108_0": "Talk",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_109_0": "Exit",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_139_0": "Exit",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_244_0": "\\E0Don't have&anything&better&to do.",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_217_0": "About yourself",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_399_0": "\\E0* The name's Seam.&* Pronounced \"Shawm.\"/",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_400_0": "\\E0* And this is my little Seap^1.&* Ha ha ha ha.../",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_401_0": "\\E0* Over the years, I've collected odds and ends./",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_402_0": "* 'Course, I've no attachment to any of it^1.&* It's just a hobby of mine./",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_403_0": "* Around here, you learn to find ways to pass the time...&* ... or go mad like everyone else./%",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_218_0": "Lightners",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_411_0": "\\E1* Long ago, the Darkners lived in harmony with the Lightners./",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_412_0": "\\E0* They were like Gods to us.&* Our protectors.&* Our creators.&* Those who gave us purpose.../",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_413_0": "\\E3* Then, one day we were all locked away in this prison..^1.&* And the Lightners never returned./",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_414_0": "\\E1* Embittered^1, the King took up arms^1, and aims to take revenge upon the Lightners that left us behind./",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_415_0": "\\E0* 'Course^1, even among his troops^1, some still distantly hope the Lightners will return.../%",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_220_0": "Kingdom",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_421_0": "\\E0* Historically^1, this land was ruled by the Four Kings^1, from \\cYCARD CASTLE\\cW to the East./",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_422_0": "\\E1* But, recently, a \\cRstrange knight\\cW appeared..^1.&* And three of the kings were locked away./",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_423_0": "\\E0* The remaining king put him and his strange son into power./",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_424_0": "\\E1* This land hasn't seen THIS much chaos since.../",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_425_0": "\\E2* Ha ha ha..^1.&* Well, you don't need to know about THAT./%",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_227_0": "We're legendary",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_448_0": "\\E2* Ha ha ha ..^1.&* So you are the \"heroes\" who are going to seal our Fountain?/",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_449_0": "\\E0* Ha, good luck^1.&* It makes no difference to me./",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_450_0": "\\E3* Neither Light nor Dark hold a future for a Darkner in my condition./%",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_230_0": "Strange Prisoner",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_472_0": "\\E3* Eh...^1? What are you talking about...^1? A prisoner with an odd manner...?/",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_473_0": "\\E1* ... No^1, you couldn't possibly be talking about HIM...?/",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_474_0": "\\E3* ... I see^1.&* After all the trouble I went through to lock him up^1, you want to release him?/",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_475_0": "\\E0* .../",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_476_0": "\\E1* Hmm^1, now that you mention it^1, it could be troublesome if he was left alone.../",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_477_0": "\\E0* Yes^1, perhaps it's better if you Heroes dealt with him now...?/",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_478_0": "\\E2* After all^1, it's not as if whatever happens^1, will matter in the end./",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_479_0": "* Perhaps a little chaos might be fun./",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_480_0": "\\E0* So then, take this./",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_482_0": "\\S0* (\\cYBROKEN KEY A\\cW was added to your \\cYKEY ITEMS\\cW.)/",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_483_0": "* If you're so driven^1, find the other \\cYtwo\\cW pieces^1, and get someone to \\cYfix\\cW them./",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_484_0": "* I'll even give you a hint - \\cYWalk where the stars don't shine\\cW./",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_485_0": "* Anyhow^1, if you succeed^1, come back here and tell me^1! Good luck!!/",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_486_0": "* If you can call THIS luck..^1. No^1, it's more like a curse...!/%",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_459_0": "\\E1* Trouble opening the door...?/",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_460_0": "\\E0* Ha ha ha^1, well^1, whether you can or not^1, it doesn't matter to me./",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_461_0": "\\E2* But here's a hint ^1- \\cYwalk where the stars don't shine\\cW./%",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_493_0": "\\E1* You already opened the door...?/",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_494_0": "\\E2* Ha ha ha..^1. I almost wish I could watch^1! Tell me what happens!/",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_495_0": "\\E2* Ha ha ha..^1. though^1, I suppose if you don't come back^1, I'll understand^1, too!/%",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_224_0": "About JEVIL",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_429_0": "\\E0* He..^1. was a funny little man^1. Once^1, the court jester^1. I^1, the court magician./",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_430_0": "\\E1* A friend...^1? Could I consider him a friend...^1? Perhaps^1, perhaps not./",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_431_0": "\\E2* But he was the only one who matched me in the games we used to play./",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_432_0": "\\E3* One day^1, he met a strange someone..^1. and since then^1, he began to change./",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_433_0": "\\E1* He started saying bizarre things that didn't completely make sense -/",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_434_0": "\\E3* But didn't completely not make sense^1, either./",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_435_0": "* Soon^1, he began to see the world as a game^1, and everyone as its participants./",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_436_0": "* As the court mage^1, and his only companion^1, I was forced to lock him away.../",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_437_0": "\\E2* Or^1, rather^1, lock US all away^1, in his own words./",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_438_0": "\\E1* Since that time^1, the strange words he's said have stuck inside my cotton.../",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_439_0": "\\E3* And my view of this world has become darker^1, yet darker./",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_440_0": "\\E2* Reflecting on these old memories^1, I think^1, perhaps ^1- I miss playing games with him./",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_441_0": "\\E3* And I wonder^1, if I hadn't been asked to lock him up.../",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_442_0": "\\E2* Would I have found a little more purpose in my life...?/%",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_98_0": "\\E0* Take your time..^1.&* Ain't like it's&better spent.",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_278_0": "Sell Items",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_279_0": "Sell Weapons",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_280_0": "Sell Armor",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_281_0": "Return",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_287_0": "\\E3You don't&have&anything!",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_347_0": "\\E0Alright,&give me&an ITEM.",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_348_0": "\\E0What WEAPON&will you&give me?",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_349_0": "\\E0What ARMOR&will you&give me?",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_149_0": "\\E2Thanks for&that.",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_351_0": "\\E0No?",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_352_0": "\\E3Y'think I&WANT that?",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_353_0": "\\E0That's&nothing.",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_365_0": "Sell it for",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_168_0": " ?",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_169_0": "Yes",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_170_0": "No",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_148_0": "\\E0What do&you like&to buy?",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_457_0": "* (Store to the left.)&* (Come on in and buy something...)/",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_458_0": "* (Or don't.)/%",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Create_0_gml_74_0": "ITEM#Star-shape#candy that#heals 40HP",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Create_0_gml_75_0": "ITEM#Mysterious#hamburger#heals 70HP",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Create_0_gml_76_0": "ARMOR#Defensive#charm",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Create_0_gml_77_0": "WEAPON#Black-and#orange",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_350_0": "\\E2Thanks for&that.",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_150_0": "\\E0What,&not good&enough?",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_151_0": "\\E3Not&enough&money.",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_152_0": "\\E3You're&carrying&too much.",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_153_0": "/*",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_167_0": "Buy it for",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_366_0": " ?",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_367_0": "Yes",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_368_0": "No",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_285_0": "\\E0What kind&of junk&you got?",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_286_0": "\\E0That's it&for that.",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_568_0": "Space:",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_571_0": "NO SPACE",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_233_0": "We Won",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_500_0": "\\E1* You defeated him!^1? You REALLY defeated him!?/",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_501_0": "\\E0* I see..^1. perhaps you three may truly be \"Heroes\" after all.../",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_502_0": "\\E1* But JEVIL was just a taste of what you'll face from now on./",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_503_0": "\\E0* One day soon.../",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_504_0": "\\E1* You too^1, will begin to realize the futility of your actions./",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_505_0": "\\E2* Ha ha ha.../",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_506_0": "\\E0* At that time^1, feel free to come back here^1.&* I'll make you tea.../",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_240_0": "Exit",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_507_0": "\\E2* And we can toast..^1. to the end of the world!/%",
  "obj_shop1_slash_Draw_0_gml_395_0": "\\E0* See you again..^1.&* Or not^1.&* Ha ha ha ha.../%",
  "obj_shortcut_door_slash_Other_10_gml_13_0": "* (It's a lone doorframe.^1)&* (But for some reason^1, you can't see through it...)/%",
  "obj_scarelancerevent_slash_Step_0_gml_49_0": "* Well^1, flip my flapjacks!/",
  "obj_scarelancerevent_slash_Step_0_gml_50_0": "\\E2* The \\cYCLOWNS\\cW are back in \\cYTOWN\\cW!/",
  "obj_scarelancerevent_slash_Step_0_gml_51_0": "\\E3* Well^1, bad news^1!&* Since you last saw me several minutes ago.../",
  "obj_scarelancerevent_slash_Step_0_gml_52_0": "\\E2* I've created a brand new fighting team ready to stop you!/",
  "obj_scarelancerevent_slash_Step_0_gml_53_0": "\\E3* Not even the purple girl can stop me now!!/",
  "obj_scarelancerevent_slash_Step_0_gml_54_0": "\\E1* Ho ho ho!!^1!&* Are you ready to be.../%",
  "obj_scarelancerevent_slash_Step_0_gml_66_0": "* Stop^1.&* Stop talking./",
  "obj_scarelancerevent_slash_Step_0_gml_67_0": "\"Ho ho ho?\"/",
  "obj_scarelancerevent_slash_Step_0_gml_68_0": "* What is that^1.&* Why are you saying that./",

  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_563_0": "* (You open it up.)/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_565_0": "* \"The Legendary Heroes: The Herald of Fun and Friendship\"/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_567_0": "* Oh^1, oh!&* That's mine!/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_568_0": "\\E0* See^1, I think it's the perfect name.../",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_569_0": "\\E6* Because we're all friends^1: That like to have a lot of fun./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_571_0": "* Okay^1, first..^1. jeez^1, that's a mouthful^1, dude./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_572_0": "* Second^1, what are our enemies gonna think?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_573_0": "\\E2* That we're gonna be BUDDIES with 'em?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_574_0": "* Let's change it to something SHORT^1! INTIMIDATING!/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_575_0": "\\E4* Something PUNCHY^1! Something BAD-ASS!/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_577_0": "* ... like what?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_579_0": "* Well^1, uh..^1.&* Y'know^1, for starters.../",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_580_0": "\\E0* How about..^1.&* JUST^1, uh..^1./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_581_0": "\\E6* \"The Fun Gang.\"/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_582_0": "\\E6* Ya know^1, just^1, uh^1, concentrating on the \"Fun\" part./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_584_0": "* It's perfect!!!/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_585_0": "* Well^1, see ya^1, Fun Gang!/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_586_0": "* I've got to osmose my afternoon milk!/%",
  "obj_savepoint_slash_Other_10_gml_96_0": "* The power of ~1 shines within you./%",
  "obj_savepoint_slash_Other_10_gml_92_0": "failing to name your team",
  "obj_savepoint_slash_Other_10_gml_93_0": "The $!$? Squad",
  "obj_savepoint_slash_Other_10_gml_94_0": "The Lancer Fan Club",
  "obj_savepoint_slash_Other_10_gml_95_0": "The Fun Gang",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_476_0": "* (Touching a wall slows your run.)/%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_278_0": "* Woah there^1, horsie^1. Ponmen're scary^1, but all'n they're doin' is following the King./",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_279_0": "* Us on the Board used to have our own boss..^1. those'n were peaceful times./",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_280_0": "* But now^1, even the boss's been reduced to the King's peon.../%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_284_0": "* My name^1? Mr. Elegance./",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_285_0": "* Haha^1, and these^1? These are my nostrils^1, not my eyes./",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_286_0": "* ... can still see out of them^1, though./%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_292_0": "* Fear not ^1- we^1, unlike the simple Ponmen^1, possess FULL faculty over our actions./",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_293_0": "* I^1, Mr. Society^1, am far too intelligent to ever bow down to such a tyrant!/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_294_0": "* Unless he asks me^1.&* He's very scary^1, you see./%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_297_0": "* What^1, you think you possess the power to topple that brute???/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_298_0": "* Yes^1! Yes^1! I'm sure everyone will support you^1! Go for it!/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_299_0": "* Just as long as I don't have to participate!/%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_304_0": "* Hmmm..^1. Mr. Elegance has run off on some hellish errand.../",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_305_0": "* Huh^1? No^1, I didn't help out at all!!/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_306_0": "* Why are or aren't you asking!?/%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_972_0": "* You did it^1! You ousted that rotten tyrant!/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_973_0": "* I'll happily accept a bounty of credit for my contributions.../",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_974_0": "* ... Unless the King reappears^1, in which case -^2- I did nothing!/%",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_47_0": "* Hohoho..^1.&* Well STEP on my BOOTS./",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_48_0": "* If it isn't the ",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_43_0": "(name I'm not allowed to say).",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_44_0": "Lancer Fan Club.",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_45_0": "Friendly Fun Gang.",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_42_0": "Guys",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_49_0": "* You boys or girls had better turn back while you can./",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_51_0": "* Lancer!!!&* What is it this time!?/",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_53_0": "* Hohoho..^1.&* I'm simply warning you...!/%",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_82_0": "* Something EXTREMELY dangerous is lying ahead!/%",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_87_0": "* Hohoho^1! It's actually really inconvenient!/%",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_92_0": "* Ha^1! I can't go home at all because I'm so scared!/",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_94_0": "* Wh..^1. What is it!?/%",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_178_0": "* Oh^1, hey^1, little guy.../",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_180_0": "* THAT??^1? THAT'S what you're afraid of???/",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_182_0": "* W..^1. Wow^1, purple girl^1!&* You aren't scared!?/",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_184_0": "* Heh^1, why would I be^1? What's it gonna do?/",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_186_0": "* Hmm^1, well^1, normally.../%",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_356_0": "* It crushes people to death^1, I think./%",
  "scr_encountersetup_slash_scr_encountersetup_gml_172_0": "* Here it comes!",
  "scr_monstersetup_slash_scr_monstersetup_gml_282_0": "K.Round",

  "obj_checkers_enemy_slash_Step_0_gml_451_0": "* Nah^1, its crown'll come off.../",
  "obj_checkers_enemy_slash_Step_0_gml_452_0": "\\E4* When I smash this guy to the GROUND!/",
  "obj_checkers_enemy_slash_Step_0_gml_339_0": "* .../%",

  "obj_checkers_enemy_slash_Step_0_gml_330_0": "* It bowed back^1.&* Its crown loosened a little./",
  "obj_checkers_enemy_slash_Step_0_gml_447_0": "* That's it^1, Kris^1! If we can get its crown off.../",
  "obj_checkers_enemy_slash_Step_0_gml_448_0": "\\E8* It should turn back into a little guy...!/",
  "obj_checkers_enemy_slash_Step_0_gml_449_0": "\\E0* Susie^1! Help us bow at it!/",
  "obj_checkers_enemy_slash_Step_0_gml_336_0": "* Nah^1, it's crown'll come off.../",
  "obj_checkers_enemy_slash_Step_0_gml_337_0": "\\E4* When I smash this guy into the GROUND!/",
  "obj_checkers_enemy_slash_Step_0_gml_454_0": "* .../%",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_589_0": "* We..^1. We did it!?/%",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_624_0": "* Wow!^1! You clowns really ARE heroes!!/",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_625_0": "* You saved the next twenty minutes of my life!!/",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_627_0": "* Yeah^1, yeah^1, I am pretty great^1, huh...?/%",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_657_0": "\\E8* Ummm^1, Susie...?/",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_658_0": "\\E8* Not to downplay your contributions^1, but.../",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_659_0": "\\E1* You..^1. didn't actually help at all./",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_660_0": "\\EB* You only made everything WORSE by attacking it./",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_661_0": "\\E1* If you had just acted nice to it in the first place.../",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_662_0": "\\E6* We could have avoided that entire battle./",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_664_0": "* Huh^1?&* Are you FOR REAL?/",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_665_0": "\\E7* That thing was BLOODTHIRSTY!!!/",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_666_0": "\\E2* The only thing keeping it at bay was MY AX!/%",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_685_0": "* And^1, earlier^1, you terrorized those troops.../",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_687_0": "* Those guys were ENEMIES^1. They're FOR terrorizing./",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_689_0": "* Yeah^1! She's right!!/",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_691_0": "* And before that^1, you ate an innocent person's cake.../%",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_709_0": "* Cakes..^1. are also my enemy./",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_711_0": "* .../",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_712_0": "\\E1* Susie..^1. Whether you like it or not.../",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_713_0": "\\E6* You're a hero./",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_714_0": "\\E0* One with the power to bring peace to the future./",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_715_0": "\\E5* Could you please start..^1. acting like one?/%",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_732_0": "* Yeah^1, when you lay it out like that.../",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_733_0": "* I've been a pretty bad hero^1, haven't I?/",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_734_0": "* .../%",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_762_0": "* Alright^1, Ralsei^1.&* You got it^1.&* I'll change my ways./",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_763_0": "* From now on^1, I won't be such a rotten hero anymore./%",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_799_0": "* I'll just be one of the BAD GUYS instead!/%",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_820_0": "* R... Really!?/",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_821_0": "\\E3* You're going to be on MY team?/",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_823_0": "* Yeah^1, sounds way easier^1, honestly./",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_825_0": "* Susie^1, you can't just -/",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_827_0": "* Quiet^1, Toothpaste Boy^1! Susie is MY comrade now!/",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_829_0": "* Hahaha^1, yeah^1, Toothpaste Boy!/",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_831_0": "* We're going to have monogrammed track jackets!/",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_833_0": "* Yeah!/",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_835_0": "* And sleepovers^1! Where we tell each other secrets!/",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_837_0": "* Ummm^1, yeah?/",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_838_0": "\\E2* Anyway^1, uhh^1, see you guys never./",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_840_0": "* Haha!^1! If you can even last that long!/%",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_893_0": "* Kris.../",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_894_0": "\\E6* Perhaps I shouldn't have been so hard on her./",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_895_0": "\\E1* .../",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_896_0": "* But^1, I just worry that if Susie is too eager to fight.../",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_897_0": "\\E4* Then.../",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_898_0": "\\E6* Well^1, let's just be kind to her^1, OK^1, Kris?/",
  "obj_checker_animtest_slash_Step_0_gml_899_0": "\\E8* I'm sure Susie'll come around soon!/%",
  "obj_savepoint_slash_Other_10_gml_102_0": "* The blocky foliage grows thick above your head.../",
  "obj_savepoint_slash_Other_10_gml_103_0": "* The power of the forest shines within you./%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_316_0": "* Hey^1, kid^1. We managed to fix up this old thingamajig for you./",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_317_0": "* It's some kinda door..^1. It can take you anywhere you want in the world!/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_318_0": "* As long as that's one of two locations./",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_319_0": "* Anyhoo^1, we'll keep working on it..^1. Anything to help you out^1, kid!/%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_322_0": "* Hey kid^1, we managed to get this door to go to the castle./",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_323_0": "* Hope it helps you out!/%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_327_0": "* ... Where'd this door come from?/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_328_0": "* Dunno..^1. come to think of it^1, I've never seen it before./%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_334_0": "* Woah there^1, horsie^1. Me and Mr. Society got this door workin' for ya./",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_335_0": "* It can go anywhere you want..^1. 'long as it's one of the two destinations./",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_336_0": "* Since it was just the two of us^1, it was tough work^1, and it might break./",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_337_0": "* Anyhow (ha ha) hope'n it helps you deal with the King./%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_340_0": "* Woah there^1, horsie^1. Mr. Society and the puzzle guy fixed that door./",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_341_0": "* Since it was just the three of us^1, it should work without any issues./",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_342_0": "* Anyhow (ha ha) hope'n it helps you deal with the King./%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_346_0": "* This door'll go even further than before./",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_347_0": "* Not sure'n what we did to make it work like that^1, but.../%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_352_0": "* Now^1, don't tell anyone Mr. Society helped..^1. he doesn't want none of that./",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_353_0": "* I'm watchin' ya now..^1. with my nostrils./%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_365_0": "* Don't mind me^1.&* I'm on break./",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_366_0": "* ... Say^1, help me^1. I need to get something for my friend \\cYCLOVER\\cW'S birthday./",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_367_0": "* Her only interests are \\cYSPORTS\\cW, \\cYCUTE BOYS\\cW, and \\cYTREES\\cW./",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_368_0": "* ... maybe I'll just get her a card./%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_372_0": "* Maybe I could put some money in the card..^1. No^1, I need that!/%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_978_0": "* Darn^1, horsey^1. You've'n done us a big help./",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_979_0": "* Now all'n of us pieces can live in peaces./%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_982_0": "* Boy^1, my nostrils can't thank you enough./%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3087_0": "* (It's a door.^1)&* (Where will you go?)/",
