  "obj_thrashmaker_event_slash_Step_0_gml_435_0": "* Guys^1? This evil plan..^1. sucks ass./",
  "obj_thrashmaker_event_slash_Step_0_gml_437_0": "* Am I at fault in any way?/",
  "obj_thrashmaker_event_slash_Step_0_gml_439_0": "* Nah^1, you're good./",
  "obj_thrashmaker_event_slash_Step_0_gml_441_0": "* Oho^1! The bad guys get off scot-free again!!/",
  "obj_thrashmaker_event_slash_Step_0_gml_442_0": "* Thrash-you-later^1, you fools!!!/%",
  "obj_thrashmaker_event_slash_Step_0_gml_465_0": "* Okay./%",
  "obj_thrashmaker_event_slash_Step_0_gml_427_0": "* Anyway^1, great job^1, Lancer^1!&* They were sitting ducks!/",
  "obj_thrashmaker_event_slash_Step_0_gml_429_0": "* Hahaha^1, yes^1! And it's all thanks to our enemies!/",
  "obj_thrashmaker_event_slash_Step_0_gml_430_0": "\\EE* Thank you very much!!^1!&* Thrash-you-later!!/%",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_647_0": "* It's nice Susie finally found a place she fits in.../",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_648_0": "\\E8* ... and she's getting along with Lancer^1, too!/%",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_654_0": "* Hey^1, you two didn't mess with my hideout^1, did ya?/",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_656_0": "* I wonder if \"hideout\" might be overselling it a bit?/",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_658_0": "* Nah^1, I took a nap in there so it's basically my house now./%",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_540_0": "* ..!/",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_544_0": "* ..!/",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_547_0": "* ...^1?&* How'd you know that was there^1, Kris?/",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_548_0": "\\E6* You're really amazing^1, you know that^1, Kris...?/%",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_559_0": "* (Doesn't seem to be anything else interesting in the tree.)/%",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_564_0": "* (There's a tree blocking the way.)/",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_565_0": "* (Might look like you can walk around it^1, but that's definitely not the case.)/%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_511_0": "* S-somehow^1, Prince Lancer's made REAL friends with a Lightner.../",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_512_0": "* S-somebody should tell the King^1, immediately...!/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_513_0": "* ... But^1, it's definitely not going to be me./",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_514_0": "* Whoever breaks the news is gonna get wrecked!/%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_515_0": "* Don't look at me!/%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_519_0": "* Ugh^1! I'm jealous of everyone with a leaf!/%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_527_0": "* How's the thrash machine we designed going?/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_529_0": "* The WHAT machine?/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_531_0": "* The machine...^1? We had a whole sequence about it...?/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_533_0": "* Oh^1, that^1. Yeah^1, we'll make it at the last minute./",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_535_0": "* You two should REALLY start working on it earlier.../",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_537_0": "* WHAT'S with the lecture?/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_538_0": "\\E2* I didn't come here for a second dad!/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_540_0": "* Heheh^1, yeah^1, you tell him!/%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_547_0": "* Being a bad guy sure is relaxing!/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_549_0": "* Kris^1, if you're jealous^1, you can be a bad guy^1, too.../",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_551_0": "* Kris isn't jealous of your evildoing lifestyle...!/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_552_0": "\\E6* (But um^1, if you are^1, I can find a nice leaf and fan you...)/%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_560_0": "* So^1, er..^1. ready to be a good guy again^1, Susie?/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_562_0": "* Nah^1. Gotta say being a bad guy is pretty sweet./",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_563_0": "\\E2* Not only is it WAY more fun than being \"good,\"/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_564_0": "* But MY teammate's PROUD of what I do./",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_566_0": "* Earlier^1, Susie ate a pinecone off the floor./",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_567_0": "* It gave her a terrible stomach-ache./",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_568_0": "\\E3* It was VERY brave and cool./",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_570_0": "* SEE??^1? Finally^1, some RESPECT!!!/%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_577_0": "* Hey^1, move it^1, Captain Toothpaste./",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_578_0": "* You're blocking my reverse-tan./",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_580_0": "* The shadow's flares are making us as pale as a horse!/%",
  "obj_npc_room_animated_slash_Other_10_gml_128_0": "* L..^1. Lightners^1! This girl's with you^1, r-right!?/",
  "obj_npc_room_animated_slash_Other_10_gml_129_0": "* Sh-She's forcing me to fan her...^1! Please get her under control!/",
  "obj_npc_room_animated_slash_Other_10_gml_131_0": "* Nah^1, they're MY enemies^1, actually./",
  "obj_npc_room_animated_slash_Other_10_gml_132_0": "\\E4* We split up 'cause I was too EVIL for 'em./",
  "obj_npc_room_animated_slash_Other_10_gml_134_0": "* H-Huh!^1? Help!!^1! Help me!!^1! I don't wanna fan forever!!/%",
  "obj_npc_room_animated_slash_Other_10_gml_137_0": "* Help me!!^1! I don't wanna fan forever!!!/%",
  "obj_npc_room_animated_slash_Other_10_gml_141_0": "* I thought I hated fanning leaves^1, but I got really into it.../",
  "obj_npc_room_animated_slash_Other_10_gml_142_0": "* (Swish, swish)&* I could do this forever!/%",
  "obj_npc_room_animated_slash_Other_10_gml_109_0": "* Urrrghhh^1, why does the King make us take care of his son?/",
  "obj_npc_room_animated_slash_Other_10_gml_110_0": "* He's not a bad kid^1, but he's so weird^1, and it's so..^1. obligatory.../",
  "obj_npc_room_animated_slash_Other_10_gml_111_0": "* ... It's no wonder nobody REALLY likes him./%",
  "obj_npc_room_animated_slash_Other_10_gml_114_0": "* B-but^1, at the same time^1, because no one wanted to be his friend.../",
  "obj_npc_room_animated_slash_Other_10_gml_115_0": "* He ended up becoming REAL friends with a Lightner..^1. A MEAN one.../",
  "obj_npc_room_animated_slash_Other_10_gml_116_0": "* We probably should have been a better influence^1, huh!/%",
  "obj_npc_room_animated_slash_Other_10_gml_121_0": "* (Swish, swish)&* Oh^1, fanning^1?&* I'm not fanning./",
  "obj_npc_room_animated_slash_Other_10_gml_122_0": "* This is a weighted leaf^1. I'm just building up my muscles./%",
  "obj_event_room_slash_Step_0_gml_437_0": "* By the way^1, beware yourselves of the forest maze./",
  "obj_event_room_slash_Step_0_gml_439_0": "* You'll probly get COMPLETELY lost.../",
  "obj_event_room_slash_Step_0_gml_440_0": "\\E2* Without someone who knows the way through^1, that is./",
  "obj_event_room_slash_Step_0_gml_442_0": "* Yeah^1! I know the forest like the back of my head!/%",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_541_0": "* So which way are we going next???/",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_543_0": "* We..^1. were following you./",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_545_0": "* Oh..^1. why^1? I have no idea where I'm going!/",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_547_0": "* (... Kris^1, let's just go wherever Lancer..^1. DOESN'T go???)/%",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_550_0": "* I was just following you in reverse./",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_552_0": "* I'm..^1. not certain what that means^1, but OK./%",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_557_0": "* Hahaha^1, come back for seconds!?/",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_559_0": "* (Kris^1, let's NOT follow Lancer^1, OK?)/%",
  "obj_event_room_slash_Step_0_gml_461_0": "* Hey^1, losers!/",
  "obj_event_room_slash_Step_0_gml_462_0": "\\E0* Wait a sec^1. Where's Lancer?/",
  "obj_event_room_slash_Step_0_gml_464_0": "* Err^1, well^1, he wasn't going the right way^1, so.../",
  "obj_event_room_slash_Step_0_gml_466_0": "* You let him wander off BY HIMSELF!?/",
  "obj_event_room_slash_Step_0_gml_467_0": "\\E0* You KNOW he's bad at mazes^1, right!?/",
  "obj_event_room_slash_Step_0_gml_468_0": "\\E9* He's probably lost and confused right now!/",
  "obj_event_room_slash_Step_0_gml_470_0": "* Ho ho ho!!^1! I'm lost and confused!!!/",
  "obj_event_room_slash_Step_0_gml_472_0": "* Sorry Susie..^1. We didn't mean to make you worry about him./",
  "obj_event_room_slash_Step_0_gml_474_0": "* Huh...^1? Look^1, I'm not^1, uh^1, worried about him!/",
  "obj_event_room_slash_Step_0_gml_475_0": "\\E2* Bad guys gotta look out for each other^1, is all./",
  "obj_event_room_slash_Step_0_gml_476_0": "\\E0* Anyway^1, get out of my way^1! I'm gonna find him!/%",
  "obj_event_room_slash_Step_0_gml_497_0": "* (Seems she doesn't know the right way either^1, Kris...)/%",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_568_0": "* Damn^1, I was SURE he went this way.../",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_570_0": "* Still trying to save Lancer from being lost...?/",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_572_0": "* No way^1, he can save his own damn self./",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_573_0": "\\E6* But^1, uh^1, tell me if you see him.../",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_575_0": "* (Kris^1, let's just go where Susie and Lancer DON'T go...)/",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_576_0": "\\E6* (We can figure out how to help them after we get through!)/%",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_579_0": "* What are you looking at?/%",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_584_0": "* Didn't he just go this way...?/",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_586_0": "* (Kris^1, let's NOT follow Lancer and Susie^1, OK?)/%",
  "obj_susieandlancer_event_slash_Step_0_gml_56_0": "* K..^1. Kris^1! Isn't that the \\cYmachine\\cW we designed...!?/",
  "obj_susieandlancer_event_slash_Step_0_gml_57_0": "\\EA* Alright^1! This will be tough^1, but let's try our best!/%",
  "obj_susieandlancer_event_slash_Step_0_gml_93_0": "* Oh^1.&* That's..^1. not good^1, actually./%",
  "obj_susieandlancer_event_slash_Step_0_gml_62_0": "* ... is that what I think it is?/%",
  "obj_susieandlancer_event_slash_Step_0_gml_68_0": "* .../%",
  "obj_susieandlancer_event_slash_Step_0_gml_97_0": "* ... yes^1. It was./%",
  "obj_susieandlancer_event_slash_Step_0_gml_233_0": "* Why did you build another one just to blow it up?/",
  "obj_susieandlancer_event_slash_Step_0_gml_235_0": "* It's funny!/",
  "obj_susieandlancer_event_slash_Step_0_gml_237_0": "* Well^1, in any case^1, you defeated us.../",
  "obj_susieandlancer_event_slash_Step_0_gml_238_0": "\\E6* I suppose we can become bad guys now!/",
  "obj_susieandlancer_event_slash_Step_0_gml_240_0": "* Hey^1, not so fast!/",
  "obj_susieandlancer_event_slash_Step_0_gml_242_0": "* It's really boring if you just give up!!!/",
  "obj_susieandlancer_event_slash_Step_0_gml_243_0": "\\E2* The LEAST you can do is show some resistance!/",
  "obj_susieandlancer_event_slash_Step_0_gml_245_0": "* Yeah^1, looks like we gotta teach you a lesson!/%",
  "obj_susieandlancer_event_slash_Step_0_gml_302_0": "* You're going to thrash us AGAIN!?/",
  "obj_susieandlancer_event_slash_Step_0_gml_304_0": "* Seems like it./%",
  "obj_susieandlancer_event_slash_Step_0_gml_102_0": "* ... how many of these do they have?/%",
  "obj_susieandlancer_event_slash_Step_0_gml_148_0": "* Ho ho ho^1! You think THAT'S bad^1, just WAIT!/",
  "obj_susieandlancer_event_slash_Step_0_gml_149_0": "\\E9* ... and see what happens when it STARTS!!!/%",
  "obj_susieandlancer_event_slash_Step_0_gml_210_0": "* Your design sucked so we blew it up./",
  "obj_susieandlancer_event_slash_Step_0_gml_212_0": "* Ah^1. I see./",
  "obj_susieandlancer_event_slash_Step_0_gml_213_0": "\\E6* ... So..^1. now what's your plan going to be?/",
  "obj_susieandlancer_event_slash_Step_0_gml_215_0": "* Turns out we didn't need a plan^1. Just a rule./",
  "obj_susieandlancer_event_slash_Step_0_gml_217_0": "* Anyone that gets in our way.../",
  "obj_susieandlancer_event_slash_Step_0_gml_219_0": "* Gets crushed into dust./",
  "obj_susieandlancer_event_slash_Step_0_gml_221_0": "* But Susie^1, you need us to return home./",
  "obj_susieandlancer_event_slash_Step_0_gml_222_0": "\\E6* Doesn't crushing us seem a little counterproductive?/",
  "obj_susieandlancer_event_slash_Step_0_gml_224_0": "* Nah^1, see^1, that's where you're wrong./",
  "obj_susieandlancer_event_slash_Step_0_gml_225_0": "\\E0* Ya see^1, I KNOW I can't get back without you guys./",
  "obj_susieandlancer_event_slash_Step_0_gml_226_0": "\\E1* But being a - heh - \"good guy\" REALLY isn't my style./",
  "obj_susieandlancer_event_slash_Step_0_gml_227_0": "\\E2* So^1, I thought of a little way we can just..^1. settle this./%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3001_0": "* If you can beat me^1, I'll go back to being a good guy./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3002_0": "\\E0* But if you LOSE.../",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3003_0": "\\E2* YOU guys will have to become bad guys with US.../",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3004_0": "\\E4* ... and do WHATEVER we say./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3006_0": "* Ho ho ho!!^1! Our wish is your command!!!/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3009_0": "\\E1* So^1, whaddya say...?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_371_0": "\\C2",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2997_0": " #Let's Fight",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2998_0": " #Let's Not",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3014_0": "* Eh^1, don't bother answering./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3015_0": "\\E2* We were just gonna thrash you anyway^1, so.../",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3016_0": "\\E3* See ya!/%",
  "obj_susieandlancer_event_slash_Step_0_gml_252_0": "* Please just let us be bad guys./",

  "obj_susieandlancer_event_slash_Step_0_gml_314_0": "* That's completely unnecessary./",

  "obj_prisonevent_slash_Step_0_gml_84_0": "\\E3* Imprisoned for eternity.../",

  "obj_prisonevent_slash_Step_0_gml_104_0": "* ... and Susie^1! Where's Susie!?/",

  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1723_0": "* (Ain't nothin' to hold you down...)/%",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_307_0": "* Kris^1, this might seem like a bad situation^1, but.../",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_308_0": "\\E6* I know you can figure something out!/%",

  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1687_0": "* (Life cannot exist without consuming.^1)&* (Even the moss drinks water.)/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1688_0": "* (Perpetuate the cycle of existence?)/",

  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1939_0": " #Do not",

  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1693_0": "* (The moss has been eaten.^1)&* (The cycle continues...)/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1708_0": "* (The cycle ends here^1, in the corner of a small cell...)/%",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_610_0": "* (It's a metal door.^1)&* (It's locked.)/%",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_613_0": "* (There's a conspicuous absence of a metal door here.)/%",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_323_0": "* So^1, Kris^1, what did you find...!?/",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_324_0": "\\E1* .../%",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_328_0": "\\E1* ... what's all that green stuff around your mouth?/",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_329_0": "* ... 2 minutes in jail and you've already resorted to eating moss./",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_330_0": "\\E6* Umm, you're a real..^1. go-getter^1, Kris^1!/",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_331_0": "\\E1* .../%",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_337_0": "\\E6* Oh..^1. Kris..^1. You^1, um.../",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_338_0": "\\E1* ... you managed to put on shackles./",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_339_0": "\\E8* They..^1. They look really nice on you!/",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_340_0": "\\E6* Um^1, very^1, prisoner-for-life^1! Haha!/",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_341_0": "* .../%",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_348_0": "\\E1* ... what's all that green stuff around your mouth?/",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_349_0": "\\E6* ... 2 minutes in jail and you've already started eating moss./",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_350_0": "\\E1* You even put on prison shackles^1, so^1, um.../",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_351_0": "\\E6* You look like a prisoner for life^1! Haha!/",
  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_352_0": "\\E1* .../%",
  "obj_prisonevent_slash_Step_0_gml_140_0": "* ... So you couldn't find anything.../",
  "obj_prisonevent_slash_Step_0_gml_141_0": "\\E6* Well^1, Kris^1! Let's not give up hope just yet!/",
  "obj_prisonevent_slash_Step_0_gml_142_0": "\\E6* .../",
  "obj_prisonevent_slash_Step_0_gml_143_0": "\\E1* But^1, um^1, if we don't make it for some reason.../",

  "obj_prisonevent_slash_Step_0_gml_145_0": "\\E1* I..^1. I'm glad I was able to meet.../",

  "obj_prisonevent_slash_Step_0_gml_148_0": "* I'm trying to concentrate!!/%",

  "obj_prisonevent_slash_Step_0_gml_181_0": "* I dunno^1, prison?/%",

  "obj_prisonevent_slash_Step_0_gml_210_0": "* Susie!^1? Really!^1? How?/%",
  "obj_prisonevent_slash_Step_0_gml_229_0": "\\E2* I^1, uh^1, \"invited\" him to visit the trash can./",
  "obj_prisonevent_slash_Step_0_gml_232_0": "\\E0* Anyway^1, now there's a puzzle in the way./",

  "obj_prisonevent_slash_Step_0_gml_253_0": "\\E0* .../",
  "obj_prisonevent_slash_Step_0_gml_254_0": "\\E2* Hey^1, how 'bout we just sit tight and wait for Lancer?/",

  "obj_lancerbattle2_event_slash_Step_0_gml_945_0": "* We might as well try!/",
  "obj_lancerbattle2_event_slash_Step_0_gml_946_0": "\\E2* I can help^1, too!/",
  "obj_lancerbattle2_event_slash_Step_0_gml_947_0": "\\E3* I'll go talk to my dad^1! Ripen him up!/",
  "obj_lancerbattle2_event_slash_Step_0_gml_949_0": "* Hey^1, now we're getting somewhere!/",
  "obj_lancerbattle2_event_slash_Step_0_gml_951_0": "* I'll head over right now!!!/%",
  "obj_lancerbattle2_event_slash_Step_0_gml_978_0": "* S..^1. Susie?/%",
  "obj_lancerbattle2_event_slash_Step_0_gml_995_0": "* ... Yeah?/%",
  "obj_lancerbattle2_event_slash_Step_0_gml_1012_0": "* Are.../",
  "obj_lancerbattle2_event_slash_Step_0_gml_1013_0": "\\E7* Are we still friends?/",
  "obj_lancerbattle2_event_slash_Step_0_gml_1015_0": "* H... Huh?/",
  "obj_lancerbattle2_event_slash_Step_0_gml_1016_0": "\\E6* Of..^1. Of course^1! I mean^1, if you wanna be!/%",
  "obj_lancerbattle2_event_slash_Step_0_gml_1028_0": "* Phew^1! See you!!/%",
  "obj_lancerbattle2_event_slash_Step_0_gml_1046_0": "* (... how am I gonna get past his dad like that...?)/",
  "obj_lancerbattle2_event_slash_Step_0_gml_1047_0": "\\ED* (C... C'mon^1, I'll figure something out!)/%",
  "obj_prisonevent_slash_Step_0_gml_481_0": "* ... so that's why^1, OK^1, Kris?/%",
  "obj_prisonevent_slash_Step_0_gml_521_0": "* ... hey./",
  "obj_prisonevent_slash_Step_0_gml_523_0": "*  Susie^1! You came to save us...!/",
  "obj_prisonevent_slash_Step_0_gml_524_0": "\\E8* I knew you had the heart of a hero^1, Susie..!/",
  "obj_prisonevent_slash_Step_0_gml_526_0": "* Yeah^1, yeah^1, don't push your luck./%",
  "obj_prisonevent_slash_Step_0_gml_543_0": "* (Kris and Ralsei joined the party!)/%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_606_0": "* Thanks for inviting me^1! This trash can's really great!/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_607_0": "* I apologize for the inconvenience earlier!/%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_610_0": "* I'm gonna invite my friends into this trash can^1, too!/%",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_591_0": "* Susie's first solo puzzle..^1. what a nice memory./",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_593_0": "* Stop remembering me fondly!!!/%",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_598_0": "* (There's a crack in the wall...^1)&* (What could be inside...?)/",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_599_0": "* (... it's more wall.)/%",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_602_0": "* (Nothing here except for poor architectural engineering.)/%",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_898_0": "* Yeah^1, even I got arrested.../",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_899_0": "* And I'm just a pair of eyes^1! What's the world coming to!/%",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_902_0": "* (Solved puzzle.)/%",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_908_0": "* Aww^1, Susie^1, did you solve this puzzle all by yourself?/",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_909_0": "\\E7* You must really have wanted to save us.../",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_911_0": "* Huh!^1? No way^1, I just...!/",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_912_0": "\\E6* I just solved it... on accident./",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_914_0": "* On accident?/",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_916_0": "* I actually thought it was^1, uh^1, y'know^1, a slot machine./",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_917_0": "* But it turned out the prize was nerds./%",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_920_0": "* Well^1, I'm proud of you^1, Susie./",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_922_0": "* Yeah^1, whatever./%",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_626_0": "* What the hell^1? Your prison cell gets MOSS!?/",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_627_0": "\\E0* (That's unfair...)/%",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_628_0": "\\E0* (Didn't even save any for me...)/%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_618_0": "* (Oh^1, oh^1. I'm just the cage.^1)&* (No one talks to me!)/%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_619_0": "* (Are you enjoying the show?)/%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_620_0": "* (I'm Goulden Sam.)/%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_621_0": "* (It's tough being the fourth cage.)/%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_638_0": "* Woe^1! Oh^1, Woe^1!&* We are the three Former Kings^1!&* We beg you^1, free us!/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_639_0": "* Once^1, all four of us ruled together^1, but when the Knight arrived, everything changed.../",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_640_0": "* Oh^1, my diamonds^1! My jewels^1! You must tell me if they're all right^1! Ohh!!/%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_644_0": "* What^1, you say? Your world is in danger?/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_645_0": "* Well^1, that's a shame^1, isn't it./%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_665_0": "* I was arrested for making a puzzle without a license.../",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_666_0": "* I..^1. I'll never make another word search^1! Promise!/%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_653_0": "* Since I didn't want to fight you guys^1, I got locked up.../",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_654_0": "* How can I!^1? You guys seem WAY nicer than the King...!/%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_659_0": "* Haha^1, I'd rather be in jail than face you guys^1! You're terrifying!/%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_626_0": "* (Us animals used to be alone in these cages^1.)&* (Now everyone's here.)/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_627_0": "* (So many new people..^1. Wish we could go back to the good old days,)/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_628_0": "* (When it was just us in these filthy cages.)/%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_632_0": "* (The sound of various animals tumbling around.)/%",
  "obj_elevatorcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_353_0": "\\EB* Alright^1, this lift should take us out of here./%",
  "obj_elevatorcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_384_0": "* Now^1, it might take a while^1, so.../%",
  "obj_elevatorcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_419_0": "\\E0* Get comfy^1, everyone!/%",
  "obj_elevatorcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_448_0": "* ... Hey^1. Ralsei^1./",
  "obj_elevatorcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_449_0": "* Y'know Lancer's dad..^1. The King?/",
  "obj_elevatorcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_451_0": "* Yes...?/",
  "obj_elevatorcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_453_0": "* When we meet him..^1. You think we'll have to.../",
  "obj_elevatorcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_454_0": "\\EC* ... hurt him?/",
  "obj_elevatorcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_456_0": "* Susie...?/",
  "obj_elevatorcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_458_0": "\\E7* I mean, I could EASILY smash him^1, but.../",
  "obj_elevatorcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_459_0": "\\E0* You guys^1, I know that's not really your thing./",
  "obj_elevatorcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_460_0": "\\E2* You're more about^1, uh^1, grovelling like total losers./%",
  "obj_elevatorcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_476_0": "\\E0* And I was thinking..^1. maybe.../",
  "obj_elevatorcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_477_0": "\\E6* I could..^1. do that too?/",
  "obj_elevatorcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_479_0": "* Susie!^1? You mean you want to try ACTing...?/",
  "obj_elevatorcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_481_0": "* Uh, well,/",
  "obj_elevatorcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_483_0": "* Susie..^1. We'd be happy if you ACTed with us!/",
  "obj_elevatorcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_484_0": "\\E0* And don't worry^1, we'll be there to help you!/",
  "obj_elevatorcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_485_0": "\\E6* You won't have to figure it out by yourself./",
  "obj_elevatorcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_487_0": "* .../",
  "obj_elevatorcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_488_0": "\\EC* ... sure^1, alright./%",
  "obj_elevatorcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_503_0": "\\EC* .../",
  "obj_elevatorcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_504_0": "\\E0* Hey^1. Ralsei./",
  "obj_elevatorcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_506_0": "* Susie?/",
  "obj_elevatorcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_508_0": "* Are you.../",
  "obj_elevatorcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_509_0": "\\E6* Still gonna make those^1, uh^1, cakes...?/",
  "obj_elevatorcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_511_0": "* Well^1, will you stop making fun of me?/",
  "obj_elevatorcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_513_0": "* .../",
  "obj_elevatorcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_514_0": "\\E2* Well^1, if I HAVE TO^1, I guess./",
  "obj_elevatorcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_516_0": "* Then I'll bake you as many as you like^1, alright?/",
  "obj_elevatorcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_518_0": "* Yeah^1, like you can make that many^1, dude./%",
  "obj_elevatorcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_605_0": "\\E0* Well^1, this is our stop!/%",
  "obj_elevatorcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_644_0": "\\E0* Hey, Kris^1. Wait a sec./%",
  "obj_elevatorcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_674_0": "* Y'know^1, I'm starting to realize./",
  "obj_elevatorcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_675_0": "* It'll be easier for us to get out of here.../",
  "obj_elevatorcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_676_0": "* If we all^1, uh^1, \"get along\" a little more./",
  "obj_elevatorcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_677_0": "* So, next time we fight an enemy.../%",
  "obj_elevatorcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_691_0": "\\EC* If you tell me what to do... I'll listen to you./%",
  "obj_elevatorcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_709_0": "\\E1* ... but, y'know, don't tell me anything STUPID,/",
  "obj_elevatorcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_710_0": "\\E2* Or I'll go back to smashing heads, alright!?/%",
  "obj_elevatorcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_774_0": "\\E0* Kris.../",
  "obj_elevatorcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_775_0": "\\EC* I'm counting on you^1, OK?/%",
  "obj_elevatorcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_798_0": "* (Susie joined the party for real.)",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2866_0": "* (Where will you ride the elevator to?)/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2867_0": "\\C3",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2862_0": " #Prison B1",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2863_0": " #Floor 1F",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2864_0": "??????",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2892_0": "* (You're there.)/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2908_0": "* (You're there.)/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2924_0": "* (You're there.)/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2689_0": "* BOO HOO^1, BOO HOO^1, UEE HEE HEE./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2690_0": "* SO LONELY^1, LONELY^1, I BE.../",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2691_0": "* BUT LO^1, THREE VISITORS STANDING INSIDE?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2692_0": "* WHO ARE YOU FEW?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2694_0": "* Nice to meet you^1! I'm Ralsei^1, this is Kris^1, and.../",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2696_0": "* So^1, what the hell are you doing in there?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2698_0": "\\TJ* I AM INNOCENT^1, INNOCENT^1.&* I JUST WANTED TO PLAY A GAME^1, GAME./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2699_0": "* BUT THE BORING KINGS FOUND SUCH FUN TO BE A TROUBLE./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2700_0": "* AS PUNISHMENT^1, THEY CRAVED TO IMPRISON MY BODY./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2701_0": "* BUT I'M FAST^1, FAST^1, CLEVER^1, CLEVER./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2702_0": "* THEY LOST THE CHASE^1, AND LOCKED UP THEIR ENTIRE RACE,/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2703_0": "* BUILDING A PRISON AROUND THE WHOLE WORLD^1. NOW I'M THE ONLY FREE ONE./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2705_0": "* Huh^1? Free^1? But you're clearly the one behind bars.../",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2707_0": "\\TJ* THINGS DON'T SEEM SUCH FROM HERE^1, LIGHTNERS!/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2709_0": "* Well^1, sounds like you don't need any help^1, then./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2711_0": "\\TJ* THAT IS UN-SO^1.&* I GROW LONELY IN MY LITTLE FREEDOM./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2712_0": "* SO^1, SHALL YOU PLAY A GAME WITH ME^1, ME...?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2713_0": "* I'LL SHOW YOU WHAT IT MEANS TO BE FREE!/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1774_0": "\\C2 ",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2685_0": "Play#a game",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2686_0": "Do not#play a#game",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2724_0": "Play#a game",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2725_0": "Do not#play a#game",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2718_0": "* FIND THE KEY^1, AND I'LL LET YOU BE FREE^1, FREE./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2731_0": "* FIND THE KEY^1, AND I'LL LET YOU BE FREE^1, FREE./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2719_0": "* THE KEY IS HIDDEN FROM THE EYES^1. THE OLD SHOPKEEPER KNOWS A SECRET./%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2732_0": "* THE KEY IS HIDDEN FROM THE EYES^1. THE OLD SHOPKEEPER KNOWS A SECRET./%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2737_0": "* BOO HOO^1, BOO HOO^1, UEE HEE HEE!!/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2738_0": "* HOW CAN YOU REFUSE^1, WHEN YOU ARE ALREADY PLAYING...?/%",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_726_0": "* (Elevator to Top Floor.)/",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_727_0": "* (Currently stuck at the top floor until someone rides it down.)/%",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_730_0": "* (Elevator to Top Floor.)/",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_731_0": "* (No longer stuck at the top floor.)/%",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_738_0": "* (Elevator to Prison.)/",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_739_0": "* (Formerly known as Elevator to Basement^1, Which Just Happened to Have A Lot Of Cages.)/%",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_721_0": "* (Rudinn's Room.)&* (Yes, that's a door!)/%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_675_0": "* We sold all of our beds to replace them with treasure./",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_676_0": "* My back hurts^1, but life has never been better!!!/%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_694_0": "* Hey^1, it's you^1!&* You're that peaceful Lightner!/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_695_0": "* Woah^1, you even tamed the beast that was tormenting us...!/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_697_0": "* ... beast^1?&* What beast?/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_699_0": "* Ohhh!!^1! You even taught the beast to talk!?/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_700_0": "* Here^1, have a Choco Diamond!/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_701_0": "* (You got the Choco Diamond.)/%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_706_0": "* I'm sorry^1, we don't have any room for that./",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_708_0": "* That's OK^1, I already ate it./%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_685_0": "* You two are real heroes^1, you know that?/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_687_0": "* What about me?/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_689_0": "* You too^1, Talking Beast..^1.&* You too./%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2789_0": " #Apologize#Profusely",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2790_0": " #Intimidate",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2793_0": "* Hey^1! You're the chumps that beat me up earlier!/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2794_0": "* There's no way I'll forgive you^1, so scram!/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2806_0": "* We're sorry^1, we made a mistake earlier./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2807_0": "\\E8* We promise we won't do it again!/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2809_0": "* Huh...^1? You're apologizing^1? I guess I'll forgive you then.../",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2810_0": "* (Your violence against a single Rudinn was forgiven!)/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2822_0": "* Heh^1, you wanna act that way^1, huh...?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2823_0": "\\E3* Forgive me or I'll crush you^1, dweeb!!/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2825_0": "* I..^1. I'm sorry!!^1! I forgive you!!^1! Here^1, take this Choco Diamond!/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2826_0": "* (You got the Choco Diamond.)/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2831_0": "* I'm sorry^1, but we don't have any room.../",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2833_0": "* Too late^1, I already ate it./%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_723_0": "* I..^1. I'll never forgive you for that forgiveness.../%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_727_0": "* I feel just OK about you chumps now.../",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_728_0": "* ... Wait^1, what about her^1?&* Will she hurt us anymore?/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_730_0": "* Nah^1, you're good./",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_731_0": "\\E2* (Unless Kris tells me to I guess.)/%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_718_0": "* You weren't as nice as I thought.../",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_719_0": "* I guess people shouldn't have heroes./%",
  "scr_encountersetup_slash_scr_encountersetup_gml_414_0": "* Rudinn Rangers came sparkling into view!",
  "obj_rudinnranger_slash_Step_0_gml_158_0": "* RUDINN RANGER - AT 8 DF 0&* Ideally multicolored, but they all wanted to be red./%",
  "obj_rudinnranger_slash_Step_0_gml_11_0": "Long live&the king!",
  "obj_rudinnranger_slash_Step_0_gml_12_0": "Glimmer&glammor",
  "obj_rudinnranger_slash_Step_0_gml_13_0": "Perish,&Lightners!",
  "obj_rudinnranger_slash_Step_0_gml_14_0": "I'm the,&diamond,&here's the&rough!",
  "obj_rudinnranger_slash_Step_0_gml_81_0": "* Rudinn Ranger gleams gallantly.",
  "obj_rudinnranger_slash_Step_0_gml_82_0": "* Rudinn Ranger puts a power limiter on its feelings.",
  "obj_rudinnranger_slash_Step_0_gml_83_0": "* Rudinn Ranger fantasizes about divine gems.",
  "obj_rudinnranger_slash_Step_0_gml_84_0": "* Rudinn Ranger pledges allegiance.",
  "obj_rudinnranger_slash_Step_0_gml_85_0": "* Smells like crystal.",
  "obj_rudinnranger_slash_Step_0_gml_190_0": "* You told Susie to COMPLIMENT the enemy!/",
  "obj_rudinnranger_slash_Step_0_gml_192_0": "* ... uhhh^1, are you serious?/",
  "obj_rudinnranger_slash_Step_0_gml_193_0": "\\E2* What good can I say about someone trying to kill us?/",
  "obj_rudinnranger_slash_Step_0_gml_195_0": "* Aww^1, Susie..^1. if you're stuck^1, why not try.../",
  "obj_rudinnranger_slash_Step_0_gml_196_0": "* ... saying something you wish someone'd say to you?/",
  "obj_rudinnranger_slash_Step_0_gml_198_0": "* .../",
  "obj_rudinnranger_slash_Step_0_gml_199_0": "\\E2* \"You are unbanned from free ham sandwich day\"/%",
  "obj_rudinnranger_slash_Step_0_gml_21_0": "No one ever&said THAT to&me before&...",
  "obj_rudinnranger_slash_Step_0_gml_22_0": "The King&never said&THAT to me&before...",
  "obj_rudinnranger_slash_Step_0_gml_181_0": "* Susie COMPLIMENTed the enemy...?/",
  "obj_rudinnranger_slash_Step_0_gml_184_0": "* \"Your outfit is NOT disgusting.\"/%",
  "obj_rudinnranger_slash_Step_0_gml_185_0": "* \"Please keep body tackling the soda machine.\"/%",

  "obj_shop2_slash_Draw_0_gml_358_0": "\\E0* I amst the Duke of Puzzles^1, Rouxls Kaard./",
  "obj_shop2_slash_Draw_0_gml_359_0": "\\E4* My hobbies includest calligraphy^1, lawkeeping^1, bugkeeping^1, cages.../",
  "obj_shop2_slash_Draw_0_gml_360_0": "\\E1* ... and long walks in the dungeon./",
  "obj_shop2_slash_Draw_0_gml_361_0": "\\E5* Artest thou one of my admirers^1, worm?/%",
  "obj_shop2_slash_Draw_0_gml_364_0": "\\E5* By the way^1, no hard feelingst about earlier^1, right?/%",
  "obj_shop2_slash_Draw_0_gml_371_0": "\\E4* Hahaha!^1! So I might amasseth funds^1, Worms^1! An army of funds.../",
  "obj_shop2_slash_Draw_0_gml_372_0": "\\E1* So that I may crushest thou like Fermented Grapes^1, into a most delicious and adult beverage -/",
  "obj_shop2_slash_Draw_0_gml_373_0": "\\E6* Vengeance!^1! Ahahaha!!!/",
  "obj_shop2_slash_Draw_0_gml_374_0": "\\E5* Oh^1, how I amuse myself!!!/%",
  "obj_shop2_slash_Draw_0_gml_378_0": "\\E2* Haha^1, why of course I wouldst sell to my compatriarts^1, the Heroes Of Legend!/",
  "obj_shop2_slash_Draw_0_gml_379_0": "\\E5* Earlier art but a Test of your Heroick Resolve!/",
  "obj_shop2_slash_Draw_0_gml_380_0": "\\E6* Rouxls is ALWAYS on the winning side!^1! Thou can bet on that!!!/%",
  "obj_shop2_slash_Draw_0_gml_386_0": "\\E6* Our Lorde King art a cruel and terrifying Monarcke!/",
  "obj_shop2_slash_Draw_0_gml_387_0": "\\E2* However^1, he is also Brilliant^1, for he decidedesteth to appoinst ME^1, as Duke of Puzzles,/",
  "obj_shop2_slash_Draw_0_gml_388_0": "\\E6* After pretty mucheth everyone else was firedst or placed inside a cage./",
  "obj_shop2_slash_Draw_0_gml_389_0": "\\E4* Truly, a benevolent ruler!/%",
  "obj_shop2_slash_Draw_0_gml_392_0": "\\E6* Yes, the King^1! A terrible Man^1! An awful Monarcke^1!/",
  "obj_shop2_slash_Draw_0_gml_393_0": "\\E2* Never likedeth that Guye^1, really!/",
  "obj_shop2_slash_Draw_0_gml_394_0": "\\E3* I just envisionethed^1, perhaps..^1. If I acceptedst this High Ranking Positione.../",
  "obj_shop2_slash_Draw_0_gml_395_0": "\\E5* I could assist to overthroweth him from the Inside!/",
  "obj_shop2_slash_Draw_0_gml_396_0": "\\E6* ... What!^1? Cannot thou conceiveth of my plan?!?/%",
  "obj_shop2_slash_Draw_0_gml_402_0": "\\E0* His Son^1, on the other hand^1, is more troublesome than a fistful of fleas!/",
  "obj_shop2_slash_Draw_0_gml_403_0": "\\E1* He alwayst asks me the Worste Queries,/",
  "obj_shop2_slash_Draw_0_gml_404_0": "\\E3* And calleth me his \"Lesser Dad.\"/",
  "obj_shop2_slash_Draw_0_gml_405_0": "\\E6* Our relation is NONE^1, you little water-beetle^1! I placate you for your Father's sake!/",
  "obj_shop2_slash_Draw_0_gml_406_0": "\\E6* I do not Wisheth to hear your MP3's^1! I would rather listen to the sweet song of Death!/",
  "obj_shop2_slash_Draw_0_gml_407_0": "\\E3* .../",
  "obj_shop2_slash_Draw_0_gml_408_0": "\\E2* How is he^1, anyhow?/%",

  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_698_0": "* (Riches.^1)&* (They shine with avarice.)/%",

  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_72_0": "* Hey^1, there's Lancer...!/%",

  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_139_0": "* Yes^1, and I think you'll like them a lot!/",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_140_0": "\\E2* There's Susie^1, she's very purple and strong^1, and.../",

  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_175_0": "* Hey./",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_177_0": "* It's nice to meet you!/%",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_187_0": "* ... Lancer^1.&* Lancer^1, my son./",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_189_0": "* Y..^1. Yes^1, father?/%",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_223_0": "* Do you remember what I told you?/",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_225_0": "* D..^1. Don't..^1. get too attached?/%",

  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_252_0": "* They have poisoned you with their sentimentality./",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_253_0": "* Free yourself^1, Lancer^1.&* They care NOT for you./",

  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_316_0": "* Let him go./",

  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_320_0": "* You want me to LET HIM GO!?/",

  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_348_0": "* I'll drop him off the edge and let him splatter.../",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_349_0": "* Unless you all KNEEL and learn your place!/%",

  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_437_0": "* Now WATCH^1, Lancer...!/%",

  "scr_spellinfo_slash_scr_spellinfo_gml_23_0": "Rude#Damage#",
  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_169_0": "* KING - Abandoned by the Lightners^1, his heart became cracked with hatred./",
  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_170_0": "* He cannot be reasoned with^1, but don't give up...!/%",

  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_104_0": "* Darkness pours from the fountain.",

  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_180_0": "* You tried to reason with the King.../",

  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_214_0": "* Susie tried to reason with the King.../",
  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_216_0": "* Arright^1, listen up./",
  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_217_0": "\\E2* Lancer's my friend./",
  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_218_0": "\\EC* So if we can get by without hurting you^1, then.../",
  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_220_0": "* If I perish^1, so be it!/",
  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_221_0": "\\E4* Show my son the monster you REALLY are!/",
  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_223_0": "* .../",
  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_224_0": "\\E3* Arright^1, you wanna see what I can do^1, huh?/",
  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_226_0": "* Susie's will is changing..^1.&* \\cYTALK\\cW became \\cYRED BUSTER\\cW!/%",
  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_232_0": "RedBuster",
  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_233_0": "Red#Damage",
  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_241_0": "* Your SOUL shined its power on Susie!/%",
  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_254_0": "* Ralsei tried to reason with the King.../",
  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_256_0": "* You might not realize it^1, but.../",
  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_257_0": "\\E6* This is a world where you don't have to fight./",
  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_258_0": "\\E8* I know if we try^1, we can all find another way.../",
  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_260_0": "\\E6* Such simple-minded platitudes.../",
  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_261_0": "\\E0* A shame you will not live to realize your naivety./",
  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_262_0": "\\E4* Now^1, perish with the pathetic LIGHTNERs you worship!/",
  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_264_0": "* Sorry^1, my friends and I aren't going anywhere!/",
  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_266_0": "* Ralsei's will is changing..^1.&* \\cYTALK\\cW became \\cYDUAL HEAL\\cW!/%",
  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_273_0": "DualHeal",
  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_274_0": "Heals#everyone",
  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_282_0": "* Your SOUL shined its power on RALSEI!/%",
  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_25_0": "Fall before&the chain&of justice!/%",
  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_27_0": "How dare you&come here,&Lightners...?/%",
  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_28_0": "You, that&left us in&the shadows,&stripped of&meaning.../%",
  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_29_0": "You DARE&return&to torment us&once again?/%",
  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_30_0": "Begone!&We have found&fresh&purpose./%",
  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_31_0": "For the&KNIGHT&has appeared./%",
  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_32_0": "The KNIGHT&that pulls&the Fountains&from the&Earth./%",
  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_36_0": "Holy&Fountains,&whose shadows&are creating&a new&world.../",
  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_37_0": "OUR world./%",
  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_39_0": "Hahaha...&Do you see&now our NEW&purpose...?/%",
  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_40_0": "Soon, this&world&shall be&blanketed&in darkness.../",
  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_41_0": "And DARKNERS&shall RULE&it!/%",
  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_43_0": "Then, you may&see what it is&like to live&in DESPAIR!/%",
  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_44_0": "Now, enough&talk!/",
  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_45_0": "Fall before&the chain of&justice!/%",
  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_46_0": "... ha,&you're&quite strong,&aren't you!?/%",
  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_47_0": "If I keep&fighting you&like this,&then.../%",
  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_48_0": "It seems...&that.../%",
  "obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_49_0": "My KNIGHT...&I shall not&fail you.../%",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_762_0": "* I..^1. I see.../",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_763_0": "* You are much stronger..^1. than I envisioned.../%",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_766_0": "* Enough..^1. is enough.../",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_767_0": "* I see..^1. I see that I cannot defeat you./",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_768_0": "* I have grown exhausted from our long battle./%",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_802_0": "* Lightners..^1. I.../",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_803_0": "\\E3* Perhaps I... I have been too cruel./",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_804_0": "\\E1* The truth is... I was not always this way./",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_805_0": "\\E3* There once was a time.../",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_806_0": "* ... where Darkners and Lightners lived in harmony./",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_807_0": "* A time where Darkners could fulfill their purpose in peace.../",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_808_0": "\\E2* It would be a lie to say that I^1, too.../",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_809_0": "\\E3* ... do not yearn for those days./%",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_826_0": "* ... Perhaps..^1. Perhaps you young ones are right./",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_827_0": "\\E2* Please..^1. let us put away our weapons./",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_828_0": "* There must be a peaceful solution to all this./%",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_861_0": "* .../",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_863_0": "* (Come now^1, Susie!)/%",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_919_0": "* I'm glad you're starting to realize^1, Mr. King.../",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_920_0": "\\E6* None of us really want to fight./",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_921_0": "\\E0* If you can just tell us about your worries.../",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_922_0": "\\E8* I'm sure we can all be friends^1, Mr. King!/",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_924_0": "* Y-yes... \"Friends...\"/",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_925_0": "* That sounds... lovely.../%",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_941_0": "* (C... cough)^1&* My apologies^1, I am.../",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_942_0": "\\E3* I am not used to..^1. fighting like that.../",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_943_0": "* My body is..^1. getting weak.../",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_945_0": "* Oh^1, don't say another word!/%",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_994_0": "* There^1, you should be all healed up!/",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_995_0": "\\E6* How do you feel...?/",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_997_0": "* L..^1. Let's see.../%",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_1067_0": "* Never better./%",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_1090_0": "* Y..^1. You.../%",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_1137_0": "* Did I say you could get up?/%",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_1176_0": "* Kris...!?/%",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_1227_0": "* Oh^1, spare me the heroics./%",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_1324_0": "* You..^1. You're the leader^1, aren't you?/",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_1325_0": "\\E0* So^1, what's your plan?/",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_1326_0": "\\E5* To laugh^1, as you cast us all back into obscurity?/",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_1327_0": "\\E5* .../",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_1328_0": "\\E0* You can't even say...?/%",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_1345_0": "* Young one.../",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_1346_0": "\\E2* Let me tell you a secret./%",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_1379_0": "* Quiet people PISS ME OFF./%",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_1442_0": "* Hey./",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_1443_0": "* Get away^1.&* From my^1.&* Friend./%",

  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_1480_0": "* OR WHAT?/",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_1481_0": "\\E4* You'll KILL me?/%",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_1513_0": "* Nah./%",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_1550_0": "* So what's your plan^1, then...?/",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_1551_0": "* To TALK me to death...?/%",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_1590_0": "* You stupid^1, stupid Lightner./",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_1591_0": "* You honestly think you have any way.../%",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_1613_0": "* ... to convince me NOT to kill you?/%",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_1973_0": "* Nah./",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_1974_0": "\\E2* But THEY might./%",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_2116_0": "* L..^1. Lancer!^1?&* E..^1. Everyone!?/",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_2117_0": "* WHAT is the meaning of this!?/",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_2119_0": "* Sorry^1, Dad^1!&* You're being overthrown!/",
  "obj_kingcutscene_slash_Step_0_gml_2120_0": "\\E0* When I told everyone you were fighting the Lightners.../",

  "obj_npc_facing_slash_Other_10_gml_711_0": "\\E3* Ah^1, did you forget what it looks like?/",

  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_699_0": "* Teen'z Corner&Monthly Toon Review:&Mew Mew Kissy Cutie 2/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_700_0": "* This reviewer had Mew Mew 2 as her first exposure to the series.../",

  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_709_0": "* (You decide not to read it.)/%",

  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2054_0": "\\E3* Who's Alphys^1?&* No idea who you're talking about./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2055_0": "\\E2* ... Why^1, did they do something illegal!?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2056_0": "\\E5* Gotcha^1, if I see \"Alphys^1,\" I'll tackle 'em!!/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2057_0": "* Fuhuhuhu!^1!&* They're as good as dead!!/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2068_0": "\\E6* Aww^1, you wanna help me^1? Sure^1, punk./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2069_0": "\\E5* Get someone to rob the bank so I can suplex them!/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2070_0": "\\E1* ... wait^1, do we even have a bank?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2071_0": "\\E5* Hey^1, get someone to build a bank...!/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2061_0": "\\E1* What^1?&* There's a Dark World inside the school?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2062_0": "\\E2* Uh..^1. SURE^1, kid./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2063_0": "\\E5* There's no law against Dark Worlds anyway!/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2064_0": "* That's a job for the school board!/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2075_0": "\\E6* Don't do anything illegal^1, you little punk~!/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2076_0": "\\E3* And lemme know if you get a lead on any purple girls./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2077_0": "\\E4* There's one wanted on SEVERAL counts of Comic Mischief./%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1255_0": "* H-How am I supposed to get past this blue lady...!^1?&* I'm stuck!!/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1256_0": "* I-I guess I should just run away.../%",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_388_0": "* (It's one of those sliding bead toys that naturally spawns inside doctors' offices.)/",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_389_0": "* (The beads march grimly along their set path.)/%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1348_0": "* Oh^1, it's you^1.&* Are you here to play the piano again?/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1349_0": "* The patients can't hear it well from here^1, but I personally enjoy it./%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1353_0": "* Sometimes the police chief comes in to play the piano./",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1354_0": "* Her playing is nice^1, but when she starts singing.../",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1355_0": "* We have to ask her to leave./%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1361_0": "* Hmmm..^1. you usually play the piano a bit more..^1. beautifully./",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1362_0": "* Is everything OK^1?&* You DO seem a little sick.../%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2227_0": "* (It's an obligatory hospital piano^1, shrunk to fit in the corner.)/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2228_0": "* (As a result, it's missing most of the good keys.)/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2229_0": "* (Play it?)/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1905_0": "\\C2 ",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2173_0": "#Yes",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2174_0": "#No",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2238_0": "* (Plink...)/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2242_0": "* (Your hands linger over the keys doing nothing.)/%",
  "obj_rudy_slash_Step_0_gml_15_0": "\\E4* Ahahaha..^1. DAD^1!&* I can't just SAY that to her!/",
  "obj_rudy_slash_Step_0_gml_16_0": "\\E6* Oh my god..^1. I'd DIE^1.&* I'd LITERALLY die./",
  "obj_rudy_slash_Step_0_gml_18_0": "\\E0* Noelle^1. Sweetheart^1.&* First time I laid eyes on your mother.../",
  "obj_rudy_slash_Step_0_gml_19_0": "\\E3* I walked right up and told her she was a HOT piece of work./",
  "obj_rudy_slash_Step_0_gml_21_0": "\\E2* R...Really?/",
  "obj_rudy_slash_Step_0_gml_23_0": "\\E7* Yeah^1, she slapped me so hard I blacked out!/%",
  "obj_rudy_slash_Step_0_gml_53_0": "\\E4* Hahaha...^1!&* Dad^1, that doesn't help at all!/",
  "obj_rudy_slash_Step_0_gml_55_0": "\\E2* Anyhow^1, how's Dragon Blazers III^1?&* Beat it yet?/",
  "obj_rudy_slash_Step_0_gml_57_0": "\\E4* Nah^1, I'm still at the Ice Palace^1.&* I've been kind of.../",
  "obj_rudy_slash_Step_0_gml_58_0": "\\E9* ... kind of waiting to finish it with you^1, Dad./",
  "obj_rudy_slash_Step_0_gml_60_0": "\\E4* ...&* Noelle.../",
  "obj_rudy_slash_Step_0_gml_61_0": "\\E5* Maybe..^1.&* Maybe you shouldn't wait./",
  "obj_rudy_slash_Step_0_gml_63_0": "\\E7* D..^1. Dad?/",
  "obj_rudy_slash_Step_0_gml_65_0": "\\E7* You should bring it HERE^1!&* I'm bored as hell!/",
  "obj_rudy_slash_Step_0_gml_67_0": "\\E8* Har har har^1!&* FINE^1, you win^1!&* I'll bring it next time!/",
  "obj_rudy_slash_Step_0_gml_68_0": "\\E5* Oh^1, it's getting late.../",
  "obj_rudy_slash_Step_0_gml_69_0": "\\E5* Guess I better go^1.&* I've got HOMEWORK./",
  "obj_rudy_slash_Step_0_gml_71_0": "\\E4* Oh^1.&* That's the group project voice./",
  "obj_rudy_slash_Step_0_gml_72_0": "\\E2* Bird guy again^1?&* What's his name^1? Nerdly?/",
  "obj_rudy_slash_Step_0_gml_74_0": "\\E3* It's^1, um^1, Berdly..^1.&* He's not that bad^1, dad./",
  "obj_rudy_slash_Step_0_gml_76_0": "\\E6* I'll kick his ass./",
  "obj_rudy_slash_Step_0_gml_78_0": "\\E4* Hahaha..^1.&* Dad^1, you're not even supposed to get up./",
  "obj_rudy_slash_Step_0_gml_80_0": "\\E7* Bring him by the window^1! I'll throw something at him!/",
  "obj_rudy_slash_Step_0_gml_82_0": "\\E8* GOODBYE^1, dad./",
  "obj_rudy_slash_Step_0_gml_84_0": "\\E2* Bye^1, honey./%",
  "obj_rudy_slash_Step_0_gml_140_0": "* ... oh^1?&* Hi^1, Kris...?/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2274_0": "\\E0* hey, look who's walkin' around./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2275_0": "\\E2* how are ya^1, kid?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1951_0": "\\C2 ",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2270_0": "Great to#see you#again",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2271_0": "Who the#hell are#you?",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2286_0": "\\E2* yeah^1, it's real nice^1, isn't it?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2287_0": "\\E5* especially considering i've never met you before./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2288_0": "\\E0* the name's sans^1.&* sans the skeleton^1.&* i'm new in town./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2289_0": "\\E2* what's up?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1791_0": "\\C3 ",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2294_0": "\\E3* hmm..^1. y'know^1, good question./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2295_0": "\\E5* i'm sans^1.&* your friendly neighborhood skeleton./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2296_0": "\\E2* what's up?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2290_0": "\\C3 ",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2303_0": "\\E5* what's up?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2297_0": "\\C3 ",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2280_0": "#Store",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2281_0": "#Friends",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2282_0": "Leave",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2317_0": "\\E2* behind me^1?&* yeah^1, that's the grocery store./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2318_0": "\\E1* unfortunately^1, it's closed./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2319_0": "\\E2* what a pain^1.&* i really wanted to buy some milk./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2320_0": "\\E5* someone oughta complain to the guy who runs it./%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2324_0": "\\E0* we just moved here^1, so i hardly know anyone./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2325_0": "\\E2* why^1, got anyone i should know better?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1256_0": "\\C4 ",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2313_0": "Nobody",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2332_0": "\\E2* oh^1, you've got something better to do?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2333_0": "\\E0* me too./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2334_0": "\\E2* anyway^1, i'll be standing here doing nothing./%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2311_0": "#My Mom",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2371_0": "\\E1* your mother^1, huh...?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2372_0": "\\E0* too late./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2373_0": "\\E5* i already \"befriended\" your mom last night./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2374_0": "\\E2* she's great. came to the store to buy chocolate kisses./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2375_0": "\\E3* said she's gotta lock her door to stop you from eating 'em./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2376_0": "\\E5* heheheh... you sound like a fun kid^1, huh?/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2312_0": "My Teacher",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2380_0": "\\E0* alphys^1. yeah^1. i know about her./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2381_0": "\\E2* came into the store with a suitcase and sunglasses./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2382_0": "\\E0* thought she was part of the mob./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2383_0": "\\E2* she opened the case and stuffed it full of instant noodles./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2384_0": "\\E0* paid in small bills,/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2385_0": "\\E0* then slunk out of the place,/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2386_0": "\\E2* pajamas trailing on the floor./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2387_0": "\\E0* anyway^1, our relationship is^1, uh^1, purely business./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2388_0": "\\E2* so^1, uh^1, i guess i'll just let her do her thing./%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2310_0": "#Me",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2355_0": "\\E2* woah there^1, tiger./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2356_0": "\\E0* you can't just jump straight into friendship./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2357_0": "\\E2* it takes time./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2358_0": "\\E3* .../",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2359_0": "\\E2* alright^1, that's enough time./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2360_0": "\\E0* take this./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2361_0": "\\E5* call it whenever you feel like./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2363_0": "* (You got Sans's Number.)/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2350_0": "\\E5* hey^1, i gave you a number^1, what more do you want?/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2344_0": "\\E2* ah^1, sorry^1. i don't hang out with idiot babies./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2345_0": "\\E5* they compete with my sociological niche./%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2341_0": "* huh?/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2392_0": "\\E1* harsh^1, but fair./%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2438_0": "\\E1* ... hey bud./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2439_0": "\\E2* ... are you busy tomorrow...?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2440_0": "\\E1* i need some help with something./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2441_0": "\\E2* it'd be great if you could come over./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2442_0": "\\E5* i live just next door^1, ya know./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2153_0": "\\C2 ",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1749_0": " #Yes",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1081_0": " #No",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2451_0": "\\E2* wow..^1. you answered quickly^1, huh./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2452_0": "\\E0* that's not good^1.&* i'm a total stranger./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2453_0": "\\E5* you should probably hesitate more./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2463_0": "\\E2* well, guess i shouldn't complain.../",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2464_0": "\\E0* huh...^1?&* what are we going to be doing?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2465_0": "\\E2* oh^1, i'm not going to be there./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2466_0": "\\E5* that'd be weird./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2467_0": "\\E2* it's just gonna be you and my little brother./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2468_0": "\\E0* he needs friends./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2469_0": "\\E2* thanks for hanging out with him./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2470_0": "\\E5* see ya./%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2458_0": "\\E2* wow^1, you were deliberating for a while./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2459_0": "\\E0* gee^1, what's wrong?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2460_0": "\\E5* don't want to hang out with a stranger?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2478_0": "\\E2* ... well, that was quick./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2483_0": "\\E2* ... hmm, well, that's disappointing./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2485_0": "\\E1* alright^1, alright^1, lemme sweeten the deal for ya./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2486_0": "\\E1* if you come over..^1. i^1, will personally,/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2487_0": "\\E5* not even be there./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2488_0": "\\E2* it'll just be you and my little brother./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2489_0": "\\E0* since he's new here^1, he needs friends./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2490_0": "\\E2* anyway^1, thanks for agreeing to hang out with him./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2491_0": "\\E5* see ya./%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2402_0": "* (Ring^1, ring...)/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2403_0": "* Hello./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2404_0": "* You have reached the Hotline for Idiot Babies./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2405_0": "* Please press 1 for Idiots^1, 2 for Babies^1, 3 for Idiot Babies^1, and 4 for None./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1295_0": "\\C4 ",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2397_0": "#1",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2398_0": "#2",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2418_0": "* Ah^1, you're an Idiot?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2419_0": "* Ah^1, you're an Baby?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2420_0": "* Ah^1, you're an Idiot Baby?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1494_0": "* .../",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2422_0": "* To tell you the truth^1, I'm one too./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2423_0": "* Let's try our best^1, OK?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2424_0": "* (Click...)/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2417_0": "* Huh!?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2427_0": "* Why'd you call the Hotline for Idiot Babies if you aren't an Idiot Baby?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2428_0": "* (Click...)/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2409_0": "* (Ring^1, ring...^1)&* (Ring^1, ring...^1)&* (Ring^1, ring...)/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2410_0": "* (The phone kept ringing infinitely.)/%",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_1307_0": "* (Knock knock knock...)/",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_1275_0": "* (...)/",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_1309_0": "* (No response...^1)&* (... but the distant trousle of bones.)/%",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_1312_0": "* Ooo^1, are you the human that lives at the top of town?/",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_1313_0": "* Wow^1, my mommy told me about you.../",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_1314_0": "* Does it hurt to be made of blood???/%",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_1319_0": "* Huh..^1. that sounds like the knock of a beginner./",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_1320_0": "* Come back when you've gotten better at knocking!/%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1276_0": "* Yo^1, Kris^1!&* You survived Susie^1, haha!/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1277_0": "* I mean^1, I never saw her beat anyone up^1, but^1, uh^1, I'd be careful./",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1278_0": "* Like^1, one time me^1, Snowy^1, and Jockington were playing handball,/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1279_0": "* And she just kept creepily watching us from the corner./",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1280_0": "* Then^1, when the ball rolled over to her she just^1, uh^1, froze solid.../",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1281_0": "* ... and kicked the ball as hard as she could^1, right into Officer Undyne's car!/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1282_0": "* Then^1, Undyne came out^1, smiling^1, cracked her knuckles^1, and totally wiped us at handball.../",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1283_0": "* Anyway^1, Susie sucks^1, Kris^1, haha. /%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1287_0": "* Yo^1, Kris^1, you look kind of annoyed^1.&* Everything OK?/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1288_0": "* You can calm down now^1, dude^1! Susie's not here^1, haha!/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1289_0": "* ... Huh^1?&* You look even more annoyed.../%",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1295_0": "* HOOH!^1!&* You're lucky^1, Kris!! /",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1296_0": "* You got to miss class with Alphys^1! It's not fair^1! Ha ha ha^1!/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1297_0": "* If I skipped class^1, my dad'd never let me hear the end of it!!^1! Ha ha ha!!!/",
  "obj_npc_room_slash_Other_10_gml_1298_0": "* ... That's actually not even remotely funny./%",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_1324_0": "* OY^1, Snowy^1, whaddid I TELL YAH about knockin' the door so hahd!/",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_1325_0": "* Don't^1!&* Do^1!&* It!/",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_1326_0": "* It's REALLY gonna hurt yah face^1! We don't have arms^1, yah know!/%",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_1254_0": "* (It's a dirty trash can.)/%",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_1257_0": "* (It's a trash can full of well-kept flowers.)/%",
  "obj_alphysalley_event_slash_Step_0_gml_25_0": "\\E3* ... O-Oh^1! Kris^1! Kris^1, you're OK!/",
  "obj_alphysalley_event_slash_Step_0_gml_26_0": "\\E8* I..^1. I was really worried when you didn't come back.../",
  "obj_alphysalley_event_slash_Step_0_gml_27_0": "\\E3* Where did you go...^1? Did you skip class...?/",
  "obj_alphysalley_event_slash_Step_0_gml_28_0": "\\E0* W-well^1, don't worry about it./",
  "obj_alphysalley_event_slash_Step_0_gml_29_0": "\\E5* I'm the cool teacher^1, y'know. You're not in trouble./",
  "obj_alphysalley_event_slash_Step_0_gml_30_0": "\\E1* .../",
  "obj_alphysalley_event_slash_Step_0_gml_31_0": "\\E4* W-well^1, let me know if you need anything.../%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1590_0": "* O..^1. Oh^1, Kris.../",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1591_0": "\\E4* D..^1. Did you want to talk about something?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1378_0": "\\C4 ",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1586_0": " #Flowers",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1587_0": " #Saucer",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1588_0": "Chalk",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_958_0": "Nothing",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_641_0": "* Huh?/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1599_0": "\\E3* O-Oh^1, these flowers...^1? They're from your dad.../",

  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_982_0": "* (It's a bunch of roses in a glass container.)/",

  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_969_0": "* (Patient Name:)&* (Rudolph \"Rudy\" Holiday)/",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_971_0": "* Hey Kris^1, you forget my name or something!?/%",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_932_0": "* (It's an angel doll.^1)&* (Its lack of facial features is unsettling.)/",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_934_0": "* That angel^1?&* Noelle n' Dess made it in youth group./",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_935_0": "\\E2* It's kind of like a good luck charm to me now./",

  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_940_0": "* (It's an angel doll.^1)&* (Its lack of facial features is unsettling.)/%",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_952_0": "* Oh^1, so you're just here to use the sink^1, huh?/",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_953_0": "\\E7* Come on^1, Kris^1!&* Be a little friendlier!/%",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_957_0": "* (It's a sink.)/",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_959_0": "* Hey^1, Kris^1, is that sink really more interesting than me?/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_599_0": "\\E2* Well jingle my goshdarn bells^1! Looks like Krismas came early!/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_600_0": "\\E1* Alright^1, Kris^1. Just gimme the straight shot./",

  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2434_0": " #Yes",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1121_0": " #No",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_629_0": "\\E1* Really^1?&* You've grown up a lot^1, Kris./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_630_0": "\\E4* I'm proud of you./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_631_0": "\\E5* Wasn't too long ago you were just the creepy kid next door./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_632_0": "\\E7* Now you're the creepy kid right in front of me!/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_633_0": "* Hahahaha!!!/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_625_0": "\\E0* Okay^1, okay^1, seriously^1, you wanna chat or something?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_618_0": "\\E2* Hahaha^1, that's what I thought^1!&* She's a PEACH^1, huh...?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_619_0": "\\E7* Fuzzy n' sweet on the outside^1, a total NUT on the inside!/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_620_0": "\\E0* Oh^1, your dad^1? Yeah^1, he's a real fruit himself too./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_621_0": "\\E7* Which one^1? I dunno^1, probably a hairy one...^1 like a kiwi./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_624_0": "\\E7* Hahahaha!!!/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_634_0": "\\E0* Okay^1, okay^1, seriously^1, you wanna chat or something?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2090_0": "\\C4 ",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_607_0": " #Noelle",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_608_0": " #Family",

  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2030_0": "Nothing",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1596_0": "* Huh?/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2276_0": "\\C2 ",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_645_0": "\\E4* She's a sweetheart^1, isn't she^1, Kris?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_646_0": "\\E0* Smart, kind, sweet... couldn't ask for a better daughter./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_647_0": "\\E5* I just wish she wasn't so..^1. defenseless./",

  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_649_0": "\\E5* And when it happens^1, she freezes like a deer in headlights./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_650_0": "\\E0* Remember she used to even be afraid of humans under the bed?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_651_0": "\\E7* (Kris^1, it was NOT nice of you to hide under there^1, by the way!)/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_652_0": "\\E1* ... anyhow^1, that's what's tough about being in here^1, Kris./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_653_0": "\\E4* Not what's going on with me./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_654_0": "\\E5* Just that..^1. in the meantime^1, I can't be there to protect her./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_655_0": "\\E3* Keep an eye out for her^1, OK?/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_611_0": "\\E0* Hey^1, Kris^1, you wanna chat or something?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_612_0": "\\E2* Don't worry^1, there's no way you can bore me right now!/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2094_0": "\\C4 ",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_673_0": "\\E1* ... So^1, why am I in here...?/",

  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_675_0": "\\E3* Yeah, it's no big deal^1. Nothing a Holiday can't handle./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_676_0": "\\E4* I'll be outta here in a jiff, then I can go back to, I dunno.../",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_677_0": "\\E2* Yelling at you for getting tangled in our light display./%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_659_0": "\\E3* Kris^1, even if we've grown apart^1, we still love your family./",

  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_727_0": "* (Didn't feel like it.)/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_733_0": "* (You decided not to sit.)/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_661_0": "\\E1* Oh hey..^1. now that Asriel's off to college.../",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_662_0": "\\E2* Y'think he's doing any CRAZY parties^1, like me and your dad?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_663_0": "\\E3* Heh^1, I'm just pulling your leg^1. Your dad was no party animal./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_664_0": "\\E7* Your MOTHER on the other hand...^1! Whoo!/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_665_0": "\\E4* She'd always fuss about going^1, but once the party started.../",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_666_0": "\\E7* Yikes^1, man!/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_667_0": "\\E7* Once she hit me clear across the room with a key lime pie!/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_668_0": "\\E2* I got smashed into the snack table and toppled everything!/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_669_0": "\\E7* Tasty pie though^1. Couldn't complain./%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_660_0": "\\E4* After all^1, me and Asgore were college pals^1, right?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_682_0": "\\E2* Then what the hell're you here for^1, Kris!^1? To gawk!?/",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_1001_0": "* Hey^1, Kris^1, you KNOW you signed the inside^1, right?/",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_1002_0": "\\E2* Why are you staring at it like you haven't seen it before?/",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_1003_0": "\\E7* Is your penmanship that good??? Was I not moved enough???/%",

  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_975_0": "* Kris^1, you jealous you don't have your own wall plaque?/",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_976_0": "* Amazing what's being done with our taxpayer dollars^1, huh?/%",

  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_1291_0": "* (Here at ICE-E'S PEZZA, You're Family.)/",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_1292_0": "* (... Is Going to Love it!)/%",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_1296_0": "* (The entrance is locked.^1)&* (No one's inside.)/",
  "obj_readable_room1_slash_Other_10_gml_1297_0": "* (Seems like all of the employees are outside in costume.)/%",
  "obj_npc_room_animated_slash_Other_10_gml_31_0": "* Would you be interested in trying some of our many 24 Pezza Flavors?/",
  "obj_npc_room_animated_slash_Other_10_gml_32_0": "* We've got Normal,/",
  "obj_npc_room_animated_slash_Other_10_gml_33_0": "* Cheese,/",

  "obj_npc_room_animated_slash_Other_10_gml_35_0": "* Gravy,/",
  "obj_npc_room_animated_slash_Other_10_gml_36_0": "* Double Ice,/",
  "obj_npc_room_animated_slash_Other_10_gml_37_0": "* Peeperoniss,/",
  "obj_npc_room_animated_slash_Other_10_gml_38_0": "* And more^1!&* Stop on down at ICE-E's PEZZA!/%",
  "obj_npc_room_animated_slash_Other_10_gml_42_0": "* Psst^1, can I tell you a mascot secret^1? I only started working here because.../",
  "obj_npc_room_animated_slash_Other_10_gml_43_0": "* The logo made me think it was an ice-cream shop.../",
  "obj_npc_room_animated_slash_Other_10_gml_44_0": "* But I ended up really loving my job^1! And my co-workers^1, too^1! Heehee!/%",
  "obj_npc_room_animated_slash_Other_10_gml_56_0": "* (Oh^1, God^1, someone's actually here...)&* Uhhhh.../",
  "obj_npc_room_animated_slash_Other_10_gml_57_0": "* Ice E's P\"E\"ZZA^1, You're number \"#1\" Spot for a piping hot pe\"E\"ce of PEZZA./",

  "obj_npc_room_animated_slash_Other_10_gml_60_0": "* I recognize you!/%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2088_0": "\\E0* Little buddy^1!&* It's me!/",

  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2326_0": "\\C4 ",

  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2103_0": "\\E8* Y..^1. You can't tell him this^1, but I really miss the guy./",

  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2105_0": "\\E3* Picking up^1, for example.../",

  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2107_0": "\\E5* Which^1, as a matter of course/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2108_0": "\\E6* May not have ever actually happened./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2109_0": "\\E2* B-but one time Undyne made eye contact with me!/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2110_0": "\\E7* ... while she was writing me a speeding ticket./%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2093_0": "\\E0* H... Hey!&* Hey little buddy^1!&* What's up?!/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2406_0": "\\C4 ",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2127_0": "\\E1* Ah^1, yes^1, Little Buddy^1. Good idea^1. Meet the Rogue's Gallery./",

  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2130_0": "\\E1* The Warrior - Thankfully absent due to pizza-related injuries./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2131_0": "\\E2* Constantly terrorizing customers with war chants./",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2132_0": "\\E3* Purple Guy - Man^1, THAT GUY^1, you gotta.../",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2133_0": "\\E6* ... actually^1, does that guy even work here?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2134_0": "\\E3* Ah^1, my co-workers^1. Where would I be without them?/",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2135_0": "\\E1* A happy place^1, little buddy^1. A much happier place./%",
  "scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_2114_0": "\\E1* Make no mistake^1, little buddy./",
